lines.text: Guard Pippi Pinecone has ambient dialogue that clues the observant player on how to initiate this quest.
I'm famished! What I wouldn't do for a sweet treat right about now.
Give Guard Pippi Pinecone 1 x Jelly Cupcake.
Oh, for me? You shouldn't have!
Such decadence! Thank you, my friend. I'll never not enjoy one of Mierra's cupcakes. It makes my brother so jealous that I'm able to indulge in such confectionery!
Your brother?
Oh yes, I have a brother posted in the smallfolk district of Night Harbor, far from the Weald. Do you think that you'll be traveling that way any time soon?
You see, my brother always complains that there's nothing sweet for him to eat in Szuur. I've always wanted to send my brother a full dozen of Mierra's beautiful cupcakes as a tease- I mean a gift!
Mostly a gift.
Could you ask Mierra to pack up a dozen for me? Then, if you bring the packed cupcakes to me, I'll write a note telling my brother to compensate you for playing the part of the courier.
Head to Mierra Willowshade near the inn.
Could you pack up a dozen of the jelly cupcakes?
A whole dozen?! Sleepers rest, I suppose I could... though you'd still have to provide me with the royal jelly I require for the batch.
Not to mention the packaging... hmm. If you bring me twelve royal jelly and a satchel from the bag vendor, I should be able to pack everything up for you.
Deliver 12 x Royal Jelly and 1 x Satchel to Mierra Willowshade.
I'm impressed that you found so much! Did you locate a secret hive? Hmm, hmm. You might just have to become my main supplier!
Regardless, let me get this dozen baked perfectly for you!
Here you are, my friend. I must say, you're probably the biggest fan of my cupcakes! Thank you once again for your business.
You receive Packaged Cupcakes from Mierra Willowshade.
Deliver 1 x Packaged Cupcakes to Guard Pippi Pinecone.
Oh, how wonderful! I'm very tempted to keep these cupcakes for myself, but I could never spoil the effort you went through to get these!
My brother should compensate you well for your travel time as he earns a guard's wage in Night Harbor.
Pete Pinecone is his name. Thank you for doing this for me, friend!
You receive Packaged Cupcakes from Guard Pippi Pinecone.
Travel to the Smallfolk District in Night Harbor.
Never you fear when Guard Halfsies is near! I'll kick evil-doers right in their rear!
Do you know a Pete Pinecone?
That's me, Pete Pinecone! Though I go by Guard Halfsies around here. Not on account of my size, but due to how generously I share half of my shift with my fellow guards!
Deliver 1 x Packaged Cupcakes to Guard Halfsies.
From my dear sister, Pippi? What a sweetheart, not to mention a sweet tooth! I suppose it runs in the family. Hmm, let's have a taste, shall we?
Exquisite! Delightful! Masterworks, all! I cannot thank you enough, my new best friend!
Here, some coin for your services. If only my cousin knew how to bake such wonderful delicacies, my sweet tooth wouldn't be so starved out here in Szuur!
Your cousin?
Oh, my cousin? Violyn is her name. She cooks at the Crimson Oasis over in Sageside these days.
In fact, you should show her that last portion of cupcake as a measure of what she should strive toward! I'm sure she'll be nothing but grateful to receive an example of premium baking to learn from!
Travel to Chef Violyn, who is located at the Crimson Oasis Inn near the North Gate of Night Harbor.
Deliver 1 x Half of a Jelly Cupcake to Chef Violyn.
That half-hearted, half-brained, half-witted, half-halfling Halfsies! Ooh, if he weren't my cousin I'd thrash him with my cooking iron!
He thinks he can tell me how I'm to do my baking? Oh, I'll bake him a batch of extra special cupcakes, you can be sure of that!
Go fill that grocery basket with the ingredients on the list! I'll make it worth your while, don't you worry. This will be a batch of cupcakes that he never forgets!
combine 2 x Dried Dragon's Breath pepper, 1 x Baladi Brew, 4 x basilisk seasoning, and 2 x Viper's Kick in Violyn's Grocery Basket.
Kidding, of course. Thanks again.

lines.text: Pine Brightreed
Taelin Goldstem
Captain Keyaryn Thornshade
You'll start off easy, new blood. Show me that those eyes of yours really do work by seeking out the scouts that I have posted around Faelindral.
Deliver these new briefings to each of them, then return to me with a bag full of their reports.
Should be easy for a sureshot like you, right? Or do you need directions?
I could use some directions.
You'll find three of my scouts posted near the bottom of each of the great lifts around Faelindral. They should be easy enough to spot for any with a keen eye.
The fourth scout, Gladebow, has been temporarily posted to Overlook Terrace due to a recently compromised platform infested with spiders. Lucky for you, that's just one span away, past the druids.
Infested with spiders?
An entire brood of widow spiders descended from the northern cliffs not long ago. They took over a terrace and seem to be forming a nest within the great tree itself.
It's one sticky situation after another with those pests, so we always need to have eyes on them.
Ah, my thanks. You must be new to the Wyrdguard. Give the captain my regards, but try not to let his quips get to you. He can be a bit wry.
Ah, new briefings? Thank you for saving me the trek, and here's my report for Captain Thornshade.
Oh, that time already? Here you go. Nothing much to report down here, aside from some nasty wasps.
That's just great. It seems the orcish threat has grown bolder of late, sending scouts into the lower reaches of Faelindral.
You did well getting these reports, though. Take this, it'll help identify you as a novice archer for the Wyrdguard.
Yes, I love to perform counter-espionage!
Aside from being a blight on the land, we're still not sure what the orcs' goal is within Evershade.
Briefings like the ones I had you deliver are not unique to the Faelewyn, though.
If orcish scouts have been spotted in the Weald, then there's a chance that they're writing and sending their own reports to some... higher authority.
What authority?
That's what I'd like you to find out. Return to Scout Amberward and tell him that you're there to gather intelligence.
You're to follow his orders and see if you can determine what the ores' goal is here in the Weald.
Return with what you find. If we know what they're after, we can start taking direct action to prevent it.
Hail, Scout Amberward
The captain wants me to gather some intelligence on the orcs.
If you were sent here to gather intelligence, then you'll have to show me some evidence that you've been accepted as a scout.
Thank the Sleepers. I've been watching the Fellstone movements for days to no avail.
Take this satchel. It's about time we strike back. I hope you're ready to take a more... direct approach,
I love a direct approach, especially if it means killing!
Fellstone scouts have been spotted all across the lower Weald, far closer to Faelindral than ever before.
Some are carrying odd reports, and I believe we may be able to learn their plans if we can translate them.
I've already eliminated a few myself, but we're going to need more of those strange scribbles if we're to have any chance at deciphering their horrendous language.
Eliminate as many scouts as it takes to fll the satchel, then return it to me. May your arrows fly true, novice,
You're a keen shot, that's for sure! Well done, novice.
The captain won't enjoy the fact that we only have these scriblings, but it's better than nothing. Perhaps he has an idea of who can translate them...
I'Il remain here and keep watch over the orc's movements. Return to the Sentinels Gaze as soon as possible.
Fair shades to you, Ianthe, and thank you.
This is what they're carrying out there? Wonderful.
I suppose I should've expected as much... trying to gathe intelligence from creatures that don't have any brains to begin with.
You're getting the real scout experience now. How do you about even more paperwork?
Ugh, I hate paperwork!
There's a researcher who spends her time in the Heartwood Archives deciphering ancient texts. Fairgrove. A kind girl, but rather timid.
She's aided the Wyrdguard in the past, so deliver these writings to her and see if she can make heads or tails of this gibberish. I'll send word ahead so that you don't spook her.
The sooner we know their meaning the better. You have my leave to assist her in any way you can. Who knows, maybe you can shoot some books off the top shelves for her.
Tell me, do you r-recognize anything about these particular... s-symbols?
These two symbols?
Y-yes, the two symbols that I've circled there on the parchment. They uhm... t-they look familiar to me, but it would be prudent if you could... v-verify something for m first.
I believe I've seen a s-symbol just like this one etched into the bark of the smaller conifer trees near the Wyrdgate,
If you could t-travel to the gate and c-compare the symbols to those on this sheaf, it w-would affirm my initial suspicions.
T'll g-go over these writings in the meantime. T-thank you, and I... I hope this isn't a bother.
S-so it's true? What could it mean that the ores are r-reporting symbols that are near the Wrydgate itself? Surely they could n-not have gotten so close.
H-here, take this bag. I now have an idea of what I can look for with these illegible texts, but I'll n-need you to help me once more in g-gathering some rather, uhm. morbid items.
Yay, morbid items!
It I-relates to the second symbol that I recognized in these orcish texts. imagine you've h-heard of the various undead that have risen from the ruins lately?
Among them are old elven skeletons from before the calamity. These skeletons are u-under the influence of a wicked magic that stinks of the... t-the Spirals.
I need you to destroy some of the old skeletons and s-see if you can find evidence of m-magical runes etched into their bones.

If I can c-compare those runes to the writings that you've brought me, I m-may be able to piece something t-together. Fill the bag with a-at least four examples, and I'll w-work on things here while you, umm... d-do your thing.
Ah, P-perfect timing! I just finished going over the o-orcish writings that you brought me. Now if my hunch is correct...

It's as I f-feared. I cannot yet translate this orcish script, but there are c-clear correlations between the runes that were forced upon our ancestors and the s-scouting reports that were being written about the Wyrdgate.

You must bring this to your captain at once. These undead are not raising out of mere circumstance, but because of a plot by the orcs. To what end, I do not know, but the Wyrdguard must be warned not to tarry with the undead disturbance!
The undead are just a distraction? Hmm...
She makes a bold claim, but I have a feeling Fairgrove knows what she's talking about. She's a gentle soul, and not one to get worked up over something that isn't serious.
You earned a little upgrade to that gear of yours, scout. Take this token, along with your scout bracers, to Craftguard Vinebrow and see if he can fix you up with something sturdier.
You'll find him in the armory, here in the Sentinels Gaze. Once you're kitted out, return here and let me know when you're ready for the next step.
There you are. Now this is worthy of a true scout of the Wyrdguard!
I am ready for the next step!
Yeah? Let's take a look at your scout bracer, in that case. We'll see if you're up to the task.
Hmm... still needs some working in, I think. Come back and show me again once I can see some bowstring wear on that bracer.
There are four elemental spirits, and thus four locations where you must look for a suitable sample. Which one do you seek? The spirit of air, fire, earth, or water?
Spirit of air
Unnatural things have been called upon in the Weald, Undead now roam the forest floor, and their very presence upsets the balance.
Would you help me, Archer, in bringing an end to these creatures most foul?
location of air elemental
The spirits of the air surround us daily, though it is within the boughs of the trees where they are the most rich and vibrant.
Enter the lift to the upper tiers of Faelindral and look amongst the boughs. It is there that you shall find a sample in its purest form.
location of fire elemental
The spirits of flame burn brightest within the night sky, when they stand out starkly against a darkened canopy.
You will have to capture a faefly that burns with the spirit of moonfire, and there is only one location I know of where they descend low enough to reach.
You must travel up the cliffs to the south, high above the pass that leads to Keepers Bight. There, you will ind a small ruin where the faeflies often descend at night, basking in the open moonlight.
Capturing one may require forceful coercion, as the flames that burn within the faeflies are both fickle and ferocious if not tamed.
location of earth elemental
The earthen spirits are often utilized by the druids of the Circle of Spores, who reside beneath the city of Faelindral.

Looking in the deepest reaches of their caves should reveal a location where you can take an enriched sample for your receptacle. Perhaps you will find it in one of the many fungal circles where they perform their experiments.
location of water elemental

The spirits of water will always follow the flows and currents that weave their way throughout the forest." Moon Dances says, "Follow the path toward their final destination at the end of the great river, and should you look there, you will find a suitable sample of their spiritual presence.

lines.text: Head to the Steel Talons Martial Academy on the Southwest side of Night Harbor and hand in your Notice of Recruitment to Fedamius Steel III
What do we have here?
Ahh... another one for Jacobin to train. Well, Archer, scuttle back down the stairs and deliver this to that ridiculous brother-in-law of mine.
Head down into the courtyard and hand your Notice of Recruitment to Jacobin Yeats
Oh! Another one of these. Where do all of you keep wandering in from?
Well alright then, how about a wager?I'll give you one arrow. If you can hit the bullseye on your first shot, you get to stay deal?
Oh, stop looking at me that way. I'm just kidding. Take this and get ready to head back out.
We’ll work on refining your skills later, but for now, the cost of entry involves you, your bow, and scouts.
The Ashira have scouts roaming outside the gates. Fill this bag with the scouts' necklaces as proof that you can hit a large, slow moving, somewhat smelly target, and then we’ll get you started.
And… don’t go bartering with the Ashira for them.
Head out to the west gate noob yard and kill An ashira scout until you get 4 Ashira Scout Necklaces
Hand the Bag of Ashira Scout Necklaces to Jacobin Yeats
These are the ones, well done! What did you end up paying for them?

I jest, I jest. The Ashira are a constant threat to our northern and western trade routes. Though, in a way, part of me is sympathetic to any creature that's trying to survive in such a harsh environment.
But we're obligated to do our part in keeping Night Harbor safe, and unfortunately, this puts us in a bit of conflict with our furry, feral friends.
Let's up the stakes a little bit and move you onto bigger game. Fill this pack with Ashira warrior necklaces, and we'll officially get you onto our roster.
Again... no cheating!
Head out to the west gate noob yard and kill An ashira warrior until you get 6 Ashira Warrior Necklaces
Hand the Pack of Ashira Warrior Necklaces to Jacobin Yeats

Yeah, that sounds about right. Great work! Your efforts probably saved a couple of the plump and juicy merchants who'll be fleecing you in the market later. Be sure to let them know, that way they'll have mercy on your coin pouch.

Now that you've risked your life repeatedly for us, maybe it's about time I give you a little information on the Steel Talons' archers. That, or you can just take this note and your tunic to the quartermaster and keep plinking away, no questions asked.

lines.text: Can start quest at level 1

Old Daoud is a wonderful friend of ours. Such a truly observant man, with a fantastic memory. It's incredible how much freight and how people move through the harbor in a given day, and yet there's Daoud smoking his pip and remembering every little detail. Such a gifted man.
Hand the Pouch of Rare Tobacco to Harbormaster Daoud
Aaahh... Master Jamee amazes me with his ability to find things that even I cannot.
You'll not want to tamper with that, lest the contents be dissolved. Goodbye now. Master Jamee has my many thanks!

One's infatuations do make for interesting study. Our lovely guard is quite the case. Fortunately one of our dangers really seems to cool the flames our poor guard builds up standing out there in the sun all day. She's provided the perfumed silken sash to help him get through the day.
Actually, I think it'll have the opposite effect. Imagine that. What a tease.
Either way, he's recently lost his posting in Highport Terrace, so you'll find him at the Northern City Gate.
It's a shame really. He must have been bitter about losing his cushy posting in such a posh part of the city.
Hand the Perfumed Silken Sash to Guard Jeskal
I can't wait to see her again!
I got this from the councilman. Please be careful in returning it to your people.

Cordellius is quite the character. He's a slithery one and so full of ambition. We've found what he needs, but we'll see how long it's him we're friendly with. He's playing a tricky game, and he might soon find that we're better situated by making that known.
Don't worry, he's harmless. You'll find him in the small library within the Spellbinder's Spire in Sageside. Don't get confused and find yourself in the larger library across the way.
Hand the Small Eye Shaped Mirror to Cordellius Hollmion
Take this and begone.
Away with you.

Elrind? People, including his family, do so underestimate that young man. He needs to get out more, and maybe we should see to that soon. But, in the meantime, his time spend in the Steel Talon's garrison library is proving to be quite illuminating.
Hand the Tiny Leatherbound Book to Elrind Steele
I can't wait to read this tonight after supper! He's always so good at finding these things.
This time, I think I've found something he'll be just as excited about. But it's for his eyes only. Take care with it.

Sweet 'Gentle' Jiselle. She is a sincere and rare jewel of a person, with such an unfortunately complicated family. It weighs heavily on her, so I hope the flower will lift her spirits some, as she does so love them.
You will find her tending to the ill in the Wayfarer's Hospice adjacent to the Traveler's Camp.
Hand the Framed Pressed Flowers to Jiselle Heyley
Jamee is a good man. I hope this helps him. You should excercise extreme caution in getting it back to him.

He's one of our newer friends... a member of that group of archaelogists from Easthymn, here to explore the various holes they keep finding in the ground in this region. Dreadful work if you ask me, but the things they discover are quite interesting. As are the people that are interesting in those interesting things.
Hand the Vial of Cloudy Liquid to Assistant Researcher Farland
Did you tamper with this?
I assume not, since you're still standing. You may want to wash your hands either way.
If the substance does its job, I'll likely have something more for him later. Take care not to lose that note on your way back. He'll want to read of my discovery.
Combine the six Small Metal Parchment Vials in the provided Small Courier Bag to create the item form of the Small Courier Bag.
Head back Jamee Langris with the Small Courier Bag.
So, what do we do with you next?
I've got it! It's about time we send you on a real adventure!
Oh yes, an adventure indeed! Unfortunately, you're not quite at the stage where you can live glamorously off your good looks and well-established name. But never fear, dear... you'll get there.

From now on, you'll live a life of danger... and utility! Just think of how much inspiration you'll gather for your great songs of gallantry. Oh, and having a scar or two makes for fascinating party conversation and pillow talk.
... I'll get to the point. I've promised someone a piece of information about a certain not-so-secret smuggling operation. Scout out the camp along the western coast, in the shadow of Fallen Watch.

While you're out there, if you happen to find a smuggler wearing a ruby-inlaid gold ring, please retrieve it... preferably with the finger still attached, if you can manage it. The ring's rightful owner will be grateful.
You're shaping up to be quite the jack-of-all-trades, which is certainly fortunate for me, as I also have a second task I'd like to ask of you.
Well, this one is rather dreary, I'm afraid. A friend of ours took an amulet into the newly excavated tomb outside the city.

It was meant to allow communion with the dead, but apparently, it still needs some work... or at least, that's the suspicion, given reports of what happened to the person who attempted to use the amulet.

Ordinarily, we'd have one of the Freebooters' archaeologists find it for us, but they've been having trouble staying alive in there. The Red Mantles are out of the question, as well, since the owner isn't particularly fond of authority figures.
The amulet itself is silver and bears the engraving of a woman's face. Perhaps they were attempting to speak with a ghastly gal.
Would you be a dear and bring both the ruby ring and necklace back to me?

lines.text: Hand Request for Aid to Captain Relgen Greenblade
Ah, you seek to aid the cause? I welcome you, young one.
You have the scent of the wild on you. Take no offense, for we of the Ardent Keepers wish to preserve the natural order between the beasts of the Weald and Faelindral.
Take this request to Aerin Mossfang in the Quiet Den. She oversees the training of those like yourself who have a connection to bestial sprits.
Head to Aerin Mossfang in the Quiet Den and hand in the Request for Aid.
I'm not one for paperwork, but I can tell you just came from Relgen. You have his scent on you. You've also been marked by beast spirits, which makes you more pleasant company than most.
You must be here to learn how to bond with an animal, correct? Well, your timing is impeccable. We've recently brought in some wounded animals that could use a little attention.
So, are you ready to help?
Yes I am ready to help.
We don't just treat animals of the Weald here. All beasts are a part of the natural order, and these ones were victims of poachers or other unnatural threats.
We've treated their physical injuries with restorative magic, but they still need salves and remedies to help regain their former strength.
Approach an animal of your choice and offer it your treatment kit, Take a good look first, then return the used kit to me when you're done.
Did I mention that was the first step in your bonding? I didn't? Well, now you know. You had to make the choice without an outside influence. So, which of these called out to you?
The jackal is an elusive and resourceful beast, with a spirit that some say is more ancient than the founding of Calafrey.
Their determination to survive makes them unpredictable companions, but they're as loyal as any canine and have the bite to match.

It would seem that the one you treated may already be calling to your spirit. Good. Take this scroll and learn to call out to your new companion. Then, tell me when you're ready to continue your bond.
Good. You've sparked an animal's interest, and now you must earn its trust by hunting alongside it, as one would with any true companion.

You'll need to keep your companion well fed if you want them to perform their best. I've given you some simple animal feed for now, but you'll have to show me that you can provide what's needed to support your partner.
Wolves or bats will be your primary meat sources here in the Weald, so choose whichever suits your palette. Fill the hunt satchel with six portions of either meat, then seal it and return it to me.
Don't worry, little Keeper. This hunting is sanctioned, so long as it pertains to the ritual. Return to me with your filled and combined satchel and we'll complete the bond.
This is what it means to hunt as one! That which were prey now serve to fuel the predator. The predator trods the land and protects if from threats unnatural.
The beastmaster is a representation of this cycle and how both man and beast are drawn to the protection of the realm.
Go on, have a taste. Return the spoon to me when you're finished.
/taste stew
With this, the first steps toward a lifelong companionship have been taken. You've protected life, you've taken life, and now you've sustained life.
Take these claws as a symbol of your initiation. I welcome you, , as a novice beastmaster of the Ardent Keepers.

For now, you're free to further your bond with your new partner, but don't stray far. Once those claws have witnessed a fair share of hunts, seek me out again and show them to me. I'll have more for you when I deem you ready.
Good! It seems that you and your new companion have had a chance to put these claws to the test.
Though I must ask you, novice... have you been hunting any of the beasts within the Weald on your travels? A simple yes or no will suffice.
What, did you think I'd be disappointed? Many of us have been forced to put down more beasts of late, as their aggression grows from some sort of... sickness.
Yes. Perhaps you've seen evidence of it during your hunts on the forest floor.
Man of the local wolf tribes have been afficted. We've lost two packs entirely to the strange madness, as they threw themselves at some of our patrols.
The black wolves in particular have been struggling the most, with the brown and gray packs retreating to their dens within Keepers Bight.
I hate to ask this of you, , but we need someone to help carve out this diseased rot before it spreads any further.
Take this twine. Cull the rabid members of the black wolf pack and wrap their hides with this.
Bring me four of their hides, wrapped into a bundle. Then we shall see if we can discover the source of this affliction and end it once and for all.
These hides have the scent of orcs upon them! Are they the ones afflicting the packs with their rotten magic?
These fallen packmates shall not have been culled in vain. I want you to take these diseased pelts to someone who has also heard the cry of the wolves.
Eraeldor Lowmist is the Elder Whisperer of the Preservers. You'll likely find him in their lodge, among the other shamans on Outreach Terrace.
Throw those pelts at his feet and demand to hear what he has to say about it
He'll also be able to cure you of any afflictions you may have suffered while you were out hunting our rabid brothers and sisters.
Now go!
Aerin was right to send you to me, young master. Her agitated song could be heard across Faelindral, as can the somber chorus of the wolf spirits.
Allow me to cleanse these skins so that their spirits may rest peacefully, knowing their sickness shall spread no further.
I can cleanse you as well, if you feel you are afflicted. Else, I believe that the Lady Aerin had wished you to make a demand of me.
Eraeldor Lowmist can CURE RABIES!!! target and /say cleanse me
You may inform the packmistress that her concerns are well-founded. This malady is indeed brought on by the orc tribes and their twisted use of magic.
To what end, I cannot say. They may merely wish to sow confusion for a greater scheme, with the fauna being a tragic casualty.
Though, if you wish to prove yourself to the Lady Aerin and appease a portion of her rage, I could provide you with some direction.
The name of the one responsible for the wolves' ailment has been whispered into my ear by the spirits of vengeance... Vorkuul Blighteye.
There is no doubt that he is close to the wolves and the source of his crimes. Aerin would reward you for this fiend's head, alongside the cleansed pelts of the fallen.

The spirits, too, would be indebted to you. They are being twisted by this orc's malice and by those who follow his teachings. Hunt those who befoul our ways of preservation, and you may draw out their master.
Killing A Fellstone shaman in Evershade Weald should spawn Vorkuul Blighteye who drops Blighted Orc Head.
Eraeldor heard the name of this orc, you say? If only my own ears were as good as his, Sire and I would've hunted down this root sucker ourselves.
Still, you were given the name of elusive prey and hunted down successfully, while also making sure the pelts have been cleansed of their rot. That alone is worthy of my respect. Here.
The spirits of fallen pack members have blessed that shawl. I'd say you earned it for delivering the justice they deserve.
You deserve an improvement to those claws as well, but I must conceive a suitable hunt first. Keep them close, and in the future, I will have further instructions for you.
The next stage of your training will involve making an improvement to your novice claws
Yes, you'll need more than simple novice claws if you're to continue your hunts beyond Faelindral.
you've already proven your worth by diminishing the orcish blight, but there's one last test you'll need to perform to get materials you need
More specifically, I'll have you face off against a much larger Calafreyan beast.
Have you journeyed out to Keepers Bight yet? There are reports of black bears in the region that have been straying too close to caravan roads and preying on innocent travelers
Black bears are typically not an aggressive species, so unfortunately any who have turned hostile must be brought low. You're to set out and test yourself against their strength

Travel the roads and find any bears that have turned violent. Put them down and return to me with three of their bloodied claws, along with any sign of what could have caused their hostility...should you come across it."
Hand 3x Blood-Soaked Bear Claw, Poacher's Arrow, and Novice Claws of the Keeper
Humans. Why am I not surprised? Their greed has driven the beasts to madness, and the bears are not the first to suffer from human encroachment upon our lands
We'll deal with them soon enough. At the very least you ended the creature's agony, and soon their claws will mete out justice through decisive battle.
Here, take the bear claws along with this pattern. There are, however, other components you must gather to craft yourself a weapon of vengeance

Find a leatherworking station or use a kit, whichever is your preference. Affix the claws onto a bear pelt of at least low quality, then stich it together with two rough threads and two sets of cloth padding
If you have any experience in tailoring or leatherworking, you may already be familiar with the components. if not, then you needn't worry. Just follow the instructions on the pattern
The combination is simple and you aren't required to make something pretty. Simply...functional. You can buy the items from others if you lack the skill or patience to make them yourself.
Return the fashioned claws and the pattern to me for the final step in their creation
I'll take the pattern from you as well, novice, now that it's no longer needed
These will do. Now to infuse them with the a spirit of vengeance...
These should serve you well enough for your next task, . I assume you can already guess who's to be the target of your next hunt.
If my duties didn't root me within the Den, I'd be more than willing to join you on this next hunt. though, my instincts tell me that the target you seek is not an expert poacher.

Head to either the North Gate or West Gate Noob Yards to hunt for a large rats, a desert bats, and a jackal pups.

Hand Beast Initiate's Cord to Leila Ghasem
Head to Blackfeather Bazaar near the Necropolis in the Northern section of Night Harbor.

Make your way to the Harbor District in Southern Night Harbor. Looking for a black rat, however if one is not available, then you will need to kill a brown rats or a fat rats until one appears. Hand the Sketch of Elian to Yorias

lines.text: Hand Hastily Scrawled Note to Leila Ghasem

You have done well to bring this note to me. Have you always felt alone among the company of men, as if an outcast? It is because the feral heart of a beast beats within your chest. I welcome you to our order as an initiate.
Your first task is simple. You are to assemble your own necklace using teeth from the local beasts.
The battlefield is the ultimate way of knowing another being. The local rats, bats, and jackals should provide sufficient test for an initiate. Take two teeth from each and tie them to this string.
Head to either the North Gate or West Gate Noob Yards to hunt for a large rats, a desert bats, and a jackal pups.
Hand Betoothed Leather Cord to Leila Ghasem
Ah, yes! This is a wonderful necklace. The spacing is good, and these teeth are fine examples. Did you learn more about the creatures you faced in battle? You ought to thank them for teaching you.
Your necklace now bears the blessing of our order. Wear it proudly, for you are now and official beastmaster of the Seekers of the Lost Eye!
Oh! Errol was fumbling around with this pouch and dropped it. I think it would be more useful to you than him, no?
Be safe, . Go train with other young adventurers and return to me when you are more seasoned.
Hand Beast Initiate's Cord to Leila Ghasem
You are now bonded to us as a kindred spirit.
We are currently facing a small crisis and we need your help, , and it's not something you should take lightly.
One of our members has gone missing. His name is Elian, an initiate like yourself, barely old enough to be a man.
He went missing somewhere near Blackfeather Bazaar. If you could, I would like you to investigate. Ask the locals in the area about him, if you can, and bring back any information you can find.
Oh, and, do be safe, . Whatever happened to Elian, I would hate to see it happen to you as well.
Head to Blackfeather Bazaar near the Necropolis in the Northern section of Night Harbor.
Hm? What's this?
Oh, this is Elian alright... I haven't seen him in a few days, I've been getting worried... You all at the guild haven't seen him? This can't be good.

I saw his rat scurrying around here the other night, it usually doesn't leave his side, but I haven't seen the little thing since. I don't know where it has gone, maybe the others at the guild can help? Please, let me know as soon as you find anything.
Oh, you've returned! Did you find out anything?
You say she saw his rat? What was his name again... Right, Blackwhiser!
Well, the next thing you might want to do is try to find Blackwhisker... Of course, most people in the city have no idea how to tell the rats apart in this place.
But we're not most people. Allow me to cast a spell on you that will allow you to converse with beasts. One day, you might be able to learn this ability yourself.
Now, go and find Blackwhisker... it will lead us to Elian.
That spell will allow you to converse with the many beasts here in the city, though I would concentrate your search in the Harbor district... I'm sure you'll find Blackwhisker among his fellow rats.
Oh, and if the enchantment fades before you can complete your mission, you can come back and ask for me to renew it. Just give me this evidence back, so I remember to cast the spell on you.
Good luck!

Make your way to the Harbor District in Southern Night Harbor. Looking for a black rat, however if one is not available, then you will need to kill a brown rats or a fat rats until one appears. NOTE: You do not have to talk to the rats. You can skip them and just speak to Whiskey, then move on to the next step.
Have you seen Blackwhisker?
Have you seen Blackwhisker?
Where is Elian?
What scary men?
Hail, and well met! How can this humble hound be of service? I hope no trouble is afoot?
Where are the scary men?
Looking for some scary men?
Well, there are some different types of scary people who pass through the harbor, some of them men, some of them not...
Whom, pray tell, are you looking for, someone in particular?
Elian
Ah, the beastmaster... Yes, I know of him, he often gave me pets when he came by. Such a nice young man. I haven't seen him since he went with those... intimidating travelers.
Oh, I do believe, I overheard one of their names... Yorias, I believe. Yes, I last smelled the man somewhere on the other side of the harbor...
Do be careful! I must say, I do not like the cut of that particular man's jib!
Hail, Yorias.
Whaddayou want?!
Elian
Who's that?! What does he look like?!
Hand the Sketch of Elian to Yorias
Haven't seen this runt, or his little rat, either.
Rat
Enough of your questions, runt!.
I'm tired of you trying to interfere in my business! Time to die, punk!
Bet you wish you left me alone, huh?!
That's Elian's scent alright... The poor lad...
What did that man say to you before you killed him? Something about Skintakers?

This isn't good. The Skintakers are a group of people who follow the teachings of the Spiral, or so it is said. They do not commune and live with beasts, as we do, but instead, they seek the fast path to power
This is not the last we hear of them. However, you've done good work today, avenging Elian...
Here, take this as a token of our appreciation.

steps.text: Moon Dances is located near the Shaman Spell Merchant at The Balanced Branch, which is only reachable from the Ranger/Beastmaster Platform

lines.text: Moon Dances is located near the Shaman Spell Merchant at The Balanced Branch, which is only reachable from the Ranger/Beastmaster Platform
Hail, Moon Dances.
I greet you. I am called Moon Dances, though I am afraid that my namesake is not so true these past nights.
What namesake?
I would often dance along with the songs of the spirits during the moonlight. Lately, however, the nights are filled with anguished cries instead of song.
The spirits of the Weald are distraught... Frightened even.
Why are they distraught?
Unnatural things have been called upon in the Weald. Undead now roam the forest floor, and their very presence upsets the balance.
Would you help me in bringing an end to these creatures most foul?
I will help.
I will perform a rite of cleansing to put the spirits of the fallen to rest, should you bring me enough of their remains.
I can part with some small tokens of appreciation for every five bone chips you bring me.
Hand in 5 Bone Chips to Moon Dances.
Thank you for purging the land of another undead menace. I'll dispose of these remains.
You have my humble thanks. I shall see to performing the rite, so that these fallen spirits are put to proper rest.
You receive a Tattered Cloth Gorget from Moon Dances.

lines.text: Squire Ryland is located inside of the Wayfarers Hospice near the Paladin class trainers. Enter Wayfarers Hospice and take the first door on the right, then turn right.
Hail, Squire Ryland.
Hello there. Have you come seeking salvation?
I have come seeking salvation.
Very well, stranger. If you're looking to prove yourself, I have a simple task for you. That is, unless you're too experienced.
What is your task?
Excellent. We can always use some help cleaning up the weaker undead that roam the gates. They lack aggression during the day, but at night, they attack unsuspecting travelers.
We can't risk them being used in a more sinister plot. Bring me any of their bone chips so that we may destroy their haunted remains.
Hand in 5 Bone Chips or any multiple of 5 to Squire Ryland.
Thank you for purging the land of another undead menace. I'll dispose of these remains.
If you hand less than 5 Bone Chips
While noble of you, i've requested that you turn over at least five bone chips so that I can see to their proper disposal.
I am too experienced.
Too experienced, eh? Then you should speak with Sir Allan or Sir Leon. These brave paladins not only saved my life, but they are great and holy men.
Hail, Bree Weatherstoll.
Hi there youngling. You seem to have wandered away from home.
Stay with us a while if you like, eat some potato stew with blessings from the Warrenmother. Fayma provides for all of her children.
Warrenmother?
She's even watching over us now.
Youngling?
Please take no offense by it. Fayma sees all the races of the world as her younglings.
Research?
We halflings have long sought out the ancient home of our people. It's our greatest hope that the desert of Szuur may have some answers.
Recently, a passing farmer took shelter from a storm here and came across these ancient halfling bones.
To the north, there is a quarry.
West of the quarry is a winding path that leads up the ruins of Tel Ekir.
It's been long suspected to have once been home to Halin people. We intend to go there soon.
If you go there and happen to find any artifacts of halfling make, please bring it to me.
No We haven't found Viridon... but thank you for your concern.
I do have another task for you, however. The Academy is in need of burnt out lightstones. If you could bring me four, it would be of great value to us.
You'll find wisps floating about the Shaded Dunes.
Oh! Very good indeed! The Academy thanks you.

steps.text: Gatekeeper Nusder may be referring to player level as 'proof of worth' here.

Give Liyna Esueiruc the Fetid Satchel
Give Liyna Esueiruc the Fetid Satchel again

Kill a pristine beetle, a sanguine bat, an old scarab, an ornate beetle, or other named that requires camping till it spawns, at the top and loot Bloodied Engraved Rune. Return to Gatekeeper Nusder with the rune and note
You receive Simple Piece of Parchment. Return to Liyna with the note and rune
You receive Scented Piece of Parchment.
Return to Gatekeeper Nusder with the note.
You receive Key to the Night Harbor Cemetery.

lines.text: Hail, Gatekeeper Nusder
Yes, what is it?
What is behind this gate?
I'm responsible for the gate to Night Harbor's cemetery and the crypts within.
Don't get any ideas about sneaking in... diseased beasts linger beyond the main path during the day, and it gets significantly worse at night. It's a very dangerous place, not for the faint of heart.
Why are there diseased beasts here?
The place is cursed. It wasn't like that years ago, but it's gotten much worse, especially after sunset.
At night, the cemetery is full of undead creatures roaming the grounds, searching for poor souls to kill and haunt.
They're the restless remains of our ancestors. The catacombs are filled with unnamed folk... buried alive, executed, or thrown in like bones to the dogs.
The outdoor area beyond the bridge is the crypt. That's where the noble families are buried. All of them seem cursed to haunt the living forever, never able to find peace.
We're powerless to stop it, and Haradrel knows we've tried. Many good men and women were lost, and we've got nothing to show for it. Such folly!
Maybe I can help stop it?
Apologies, but I don't trust you to do anything but add to our troubles.
My duty matters to me, and without proof of your worth, I won't risk another life on this venture.
Gatekeeper Nusder may be referring to player level as 'proof of worth' here.
How can I prove my worth?
You at least look like you can hold your own.
There's one thing we've yet to try... analyzing the source of the curse. If we could figure it out, maybe we could strike at its source and get rid of it.
Fine! Go and grab the diseased flesh of the beasts during the day. Fill this sack with ten samples so there's plenty to analyze.
If you can return to me still alive, we might be able to get the samples looked at in Sageside.
Let me make myself clear... do NOT linger in the cemetery after Eth has set. I don't want another death on my conscience!
Enter the gate and kill a diseased bat or a catacombs rat and loot Chunk of Diseased Meat x10. The meat is NODROP and not guaranteed on every kill, so plan accordingly if grouping here.
After combining the meats in the satchel, you receive Fetid Satchel. Return Fetid Satchel to Gatekeeper Nusder
You had me worried. I'm glad you're still breathing!
...And you've got the flesh we needed, well done.
Now, bring the satchel to my friend Liyna in Sageside. You'll find her in the Grand Library.
Ask her to take a closer look at the flesh and see if she can find anything.
Find Liyna Esueiruc in the second floor (teleporter puts you on floor 3) of the library (which is due east from Gatekeeper Nusder, at the Spellbinders of the Spire)
Hail, Liyna Esueiruc
What's this you're carrying? I can sense something isn't right...
Give Liyna Esueiruc the Fetid Satchel
The smell... and the cursed energy emanating from this! What is Nusder getting himself into? This can't be good.
Are you certain this is something you want to be involved in?
Yes
He must've seen something in you if he sent you to me.
There, hand me the bag once more, I should be able to handle it without risk now.
Give Liyna Esueiruc the Fetid Satchel again
An old scent... cursed magic from another generation. I'm not surprised it's coming from the graveyard.
The result of an ancient form of necromancy... I'm sure of it.
We need to dig deeper.
The diseased beasts are just a byproduct of what's really happening there. We need to find the source.
Take this note to Nusder right away.
You receive Lightly Scented Piece of Parchment from Liyna Esueiruc.
Return to Nusder with the Lightly Scented Piece of Parchment
A note? Give me a second to read through Liyna's words.
Hmm... I feared she would say that.
Are you sure you want to keep going?
Yes
It's been a while since I've seen someone so eager to throw themselves into the maw of death.
You remind me of my younger self. I'd be remiss not to give you a chance.
When you feel ready, head back into the cemetery during the day with a valiant group of adventurers and look for any signs of necromancy.
It won't be easy to find, but if you do, come back to me immediately with the note and proof of it.

Kill a pristine beetle, a sanguine bat, an old scarab, an ornate beetle, or other named that requires camping till it spawns, at the top and loot Bloodied Engraved Rune. Return to Gatekeeper Nusder with the rune and note
What's this you've found?
I'm not certain what it means... but then again, it's not something I've seen before. Let me quickly write to Liyna.
Here, take this note and the rune to Liyna right away!
You receive Simple Piece of Parchment. Return to Liyna with the note and rune
An even stronger remnant of cursed magic... Now I'm sure of it. There's something, or someone, hiding in the cemetery, and they're doing more than just hiding.
We need more clues, but the cemetery's beasts won't carry them.
You know what this means, don't you?
Please share this message with Nusder and see whether he's of a same mind.
In the meanwhile I'll keep studying this rune and see if there's more we can figure out.
You receive Scented Piece of Parchment.
Return to Gatekeeper Nusder with the note.
I see how it is... so be it. We have no other choice.
I'm entrusting you with the task of finding more clues.
You receive Key to the Night Harbor Cemetery.
You've earned yourself a key to the cemetery, but use it with the utmost care. Stepping foot in there at night will test your mettle, and your life will be at great risk!
Haradrel be with you, adventurer. We're onto something...

steps.text: Give Cheikho 1x Chomper's Hide.

lines.text: Hail, Cheikho.
Hail to you, friend!
We're hunting the nearby beach for crocodiles. If you have meat or skins for us, we're happy to purchase them. We also have some goods for sale. Take a look!
Crocodiles?
Yes, down along the shoreline. But take care... this area has more dangers than just the crocodiles.
More dangers?
Look around friend! How did you make it this far without dying?

There's undead just over the dunes to the northeast, smugglers to our west, and giant scouts prowling around at night... and to top it all off, there's a particularly large and hostile croc wandering about named Chompers.
You'd best take care when running around here.
Chompers?
Yeah, Chompers. Nasty feller. I bet his hide would make one heck of a tunic, though.
Give Cheikho 1x Chomper's Hide.
Cheikho gives you Chompers' Hide Tunic.

Hand Millicent's List, Dalinder's Tunic, 2 Blister Beetle Gland, the Intact Diseased Bat Bile Duct, and the Moondew Moss to Millicent Domaire

lines.text: Hand Formal Note to Thibald Burlond in the Wayfarer's Hospice north of the West Gate
Welcome to the Wayfarers Hospice. I am Grand Master Thibald Burlond of the Penitent Knights of the Hospice.
We accept the assistance of all who aid the less fortunate and suffering, regardless of tehir background or beliefs.
We have an impeccable reputation within this city and with its leadership. All we ask is that you do not sully it.
Now, take the note you've given me upstairs to Jiselle Heyley. She will guide you from here.
Hand Formal Note to Jiselle Heyley upstairs.
I heard the Grand Master from here, no need for this!
As Thibald said, welcome to the Hospice. It's a kindness you pay us in being here. Thank you.
As you look around, you'll find that we spend most of our time comforting those at their journey's end, particularly those without better means, families, or friends.
Clerics can alleviate most ailments, but there's no cure for age... at least, none that my conscience will allow me to pursue, lest we find ourselves consorting with the likes of necromancers!
Well... let's focus on what we can do. Take this and show it to Dalinder. He's in his laboratory.
Hand Penitent Knight's Coin to Dalinder Grammanoot downstairs.
Just getting into town? We do have bathhouses here, you know. Use them if you're going to be coming in here regularly.
Let's get started. Take this bag. Take your coin. Do not put the coin in the bag. Put the coin in your pocket. Fasten the bag firmly. Do not lose it.

Jiselle is a wonderful human, but they call her gentle for a reason. She has a soft heart... especially for critters. Unfortunately, the work that Milli and I do can occasionally call for hearts, glands, bile ducts, venom sacs, and the like. So, spare her the details, eh?
For now I'm running low on snake venom sacs... but not the fully developed ones, just the immature kind. Fill the bag for me, and I'll go see if Millicent needs anything.
Be careful out there. I hope to see you again soon.
Head to the West Gate Noob Yard and kill a snakes until you receive 6 Immature Snake Venom Sacs. Alternatively you can buy them.
Return to Dalinder Grammanoot and hand in your Bag of Venom Sacs
Splendid, thank you!
Hmm... clearly that was hard work, given the heat and all.
You can change into this, though maybe wait until after you've bathed.
Millicent said she needs a few items as well. Here's her list.
Hand Millicent's List, Dalinder's Tunic, 2 Blister Beetle Gland, the Intact Diseased Bat Bile Duct, and the Moondew Moss to Millicent Domaire
There we go. I appreciate the assistance.

I'm... I'm sorry, where are we? Ah, yes... the tunic. Don it, and keep the coin Jiselle gave you on your person. We have a lot of new people arriving these days, so you can use it to indicate your association with the Hospice.
I'm sure I'll need your assistance again soon. In the meantime, please take the opportunity to get to know everyone here.

steps.text: Hand in the note to Soren Akedd.
If you didn't hand him the note, you can still start this quest as so
Either way, you can ask about the work.
Go out the front of the building and take a left. The chapel is very close and has a red glow inside. Go inside, walk all the way up to the altar in front of the statue and /look.
Pick up the Strange Effigy in your inventory so that it's on your cursor, then /place effigy.
Take the Offering Bowl back to Soren and hand it in to him.
Sister Marwen is on the porch of the chapel. She is a cleric trainer.

If you head out the tunnel that leads to the city, the unworthy you are looking for are both high and low on the waterfront where the tunnels come out: a craven neophyte, a failed knight, an unworthy aspirant.
Kill them until you get Stained Servant's Robe x4.
Combine them in the Robe Box to get the Full Robe Box.
Hand the Full Robe Box in to Sister Marwen.

At level 8 Sister Marwen has the next step for you.
Lady Tabitha is in the morgue (same building as Soren).

Hand Full Snake Gland Pouch you get after the combine

lines.text: Hand in the note to Soren Akedd.
You have done well to come when called NAME. This is the House of Ygorath, which you may call home, if you are deemed worthy to carry out his work.
If you didn't hand him the note, you can still start this quest as so
Hail, Soren Akedd.
You appear before me as you were in my nightmare, NAME.
Nightmare?
Nightmares are visits from Ygorath, gifted upon all the fearful of this land. It was my nightmare that called you here to begin his work.
Either way, you can ask about the work.
What work?
It is the work of trembling hands to raise both the living and the dead upon his altar. It is for their salvation as much as our own.
Many souls walk Eth-up practicing feints of valor, but Ygorath's wisdom knows bravery to be a thin sheen upon a bottomless terror. We must usher them into his kingdom with right fear in their hearts.
This you must do, Cleric, whether by sign or by sword. If you pass the test.
What is the test?
But I must warn you... cast your gaze downward and look not upon the visage of Ygorath.
Go out the front of the building and take a left. The chapel is very close and has a red glow inside. Go inside, walk all the way up to the altar in front of the statue and /look.
Pick up the Strange Effigy in your inventory so that it's on your cursor, then /place effigy.
Take the Offering Bowl back to Soren and hand it in to him.
Your eyes are open. Take this drape and rise a new servant of Ygorath.
Sister Marwen is on the porch of the chapel. She is a cleric trainer.
Hail, Sister Marwen.
Well met. Spreading the word of Ygorath is not for the faint of heart. Will you accept the duties required of you?
I accept.
We shall see. There are those who shirk their duties.

Sometimes the unworthy linger, hoping to regain entry to the temple. Go to the mortuary that overlooks the water and look for those who have abandoned their calling. many still wear the drape of the temple. Reclaim no fewer than four robes and return them to me in this box.

If you head out the tunnel that leads to the city, the unworthy you are looking for are both high and low on the waterfront where the tunnels come out: a craven neophyte, a failed knight, an unworthy aspirant.
Kill them until you get Stained Servant's Robe x4.
Combine them in the Robe Box to get the Full Robe Box.
Hand the Full Robe Box in to Sister Marwen.
Our duty is to give and to take as Ygorath commands. Take this shield and bear it proudly, no matter what you are called upon to do.
If you hail her again she says to come back later.
Hail, Sister Marwen.
Attend to your duties, young one. Return when you are stronger.
At level 8 Sister Marwen has the next step for you.
Hail, Sister Marwen.
Your faith in Ygorath strengthens your resolve, Cleric. Look for Lady Tabitha in the temple and offer her your services. She is an alchemist of some repute.
Lady Tabitha is in the morgue (same building as Soren).
Hail, Lady Tabitha.
Oh, here's a new on. Who sent you to me? Or have you become a nuisance of your own volition?
Sister Marwen sent me.
What ingredients?
Poison and antidote are cut from the same cloth, Cleric. Go and collect as many snake venom glands as this will carry.
Undamaged, if you please.
Need to fufill the Snake Gland Pouch with 8 Deepscale Venom Gland drop from Deepscale Slitherer
Hand Full Snake Gland Pouch you get after the combine
Hand Alchemist's Reference Letter to Sister Marwen
Give both : Alchemist's Reference Letter and your Splintered Servant's Buckler

steps.text: Put 6 Cloth Scraps within the container and combine into Bundled Scraps.
Give container of Bundled Scraps to a shifty gnome

lines.text: Hail, a shifty gnome
What work?
I am interested
Put 6 Cloth Scraps within the container and combine into Bundled Scraps.
Give container of Bundled Scraps to a shifty gnome
Hail, Researcher Fairgrove.
Ah, h-hello, yes. You'll have to e-excuse me, I'm terribly busy with all these... w-writings!
What writings?
O-oh yes, have you not heard? Fellstone scouts have been spotted roaming the Weald and... and w-writing things!
T-terrible things, no doubt. I'm doing what I can to a-aid the Wyrdguard by attempting to d-decipher their script, but it's so... s-so very alien.
B-be that as it may, I w-would... still greatly appreciate any additional writings of theirs to study, should you happen to come a-across them in your journeys.
T-thank you very much for your assistance! The m-more of these writings I can study, the... the closer I believe I am to uncovering their meanings.
It i-isn't much, but here is a little something for going o-out of your way for me.

quests.title: Diseased Wolf Pelts for Baewyn Mossfang

lines.text: Hail, Baewyn Mossfang.
Hello, friend. Do not let the fierceness of my sister discourage you from visiting the Den. She is right to be upset as she is.
Why is she upset?
Many of the Weald's great wolves have fallen prey to a terrible malady, beset upon them by foul magic.
There are many that we cannot cure in time before they throw themselves at travelers or guards.
Their hides then rot and decay, spreading the sickness further. Would that I could descend to the forest floor myself, but my duties keep me here and there is no one to go on my behalf.
I could go on your behalf.
Would you be willing to go? I would be indebted to you, Cleric.
If you are forced to put down any of the mad wolves, bring their infected hides to me for purification. They will be of no use to you for craft or sale otherwise.
Deliver 1 x Diseased Wolf Pelt to Baewyn Mossfang.
You have my appreciation for this, Cleric. My sister is on the hunt for the source, but we must always do what we can to prevent the spread of illness.
Please, accept this as a small measure of my gratitude. I am also able to provide cleansing to you if the illness has taken hold.

steps.text: 1. Ring the bell and take the lift up and make your way to the 'Upper Tier'.
You can find Sylvarya Starveil in the un-named half house on the 'Upper Tier'
Hand Rolled Leafscroll to Sylvarya Starveil.

2. take the lift down at the neighboring platform from where you speak to Sylvarya (Note: guard Galen is standing by the lift; this is not the newbie lift you start at. It is marked as the Pixie Lift on the Faelindral map), and stand in the center of the circle of toadstools
3. /take water (while holding the Empty Phial)
4. take the lift back up and return to Sylvarya Starveil.

You receive Novice Icon of the Gatekeeper.

Kill a black bat for Bat Wing, a wasp drone for Royal Jelly and a rotting skeleton for Bone Chips.

Hand Full Reagent Bag to Sylwine Brightspirit.
head back to Sylvarya Starveil and give her the Novice Icon of the Gatekeeper and the Note of Results.

Say to Sylvarya Starveil "I am ready to see the paths"

Sylvarya will teleport you to the Sungreet Strand Druid ring.

Gate to Evershade Weald and hand the letter to Sylvarya.
Sylvarya hands you Druidic Token.
Hand the token to Commander Elydris Stormbough.
She hands you Vine-Strapped Satchel.
Kill a Fellstone shaman until you have x4 Broken Shaman Idol. Combine those in the satchel and receive Full Vine-Strapped Satchel.
Hand the satchel to Commander Stormbough.
She hands you the satchel. Take it to Sylvarya.
She hands you Sap-Stained Gloves.
If you hail her, she will say the follow
Hand Sap-Stained Gloves to Sylvarya. She will return them.
She hands you Lodestone.
You say, "I am ready to assist."
You say, "What conclusion?"
You say, "I will use my gifts."

Go to the orc valley and make your way to the ramps that lead up from near the spires that spawn skeletons and rabid dogs just near the road out of the zone. Go up the ramp and then turn left. Head to the end of the road on the cliff and you'll see a moss archway drawn onto the cliff face. This is the moss circle.
While standing near the moss circle and with the lodestone on your cursor, /place lodestone.
You receive Attuned Lodestone. ***After about 10 seconds three orcs will spawn - run or Gate.
Hand the attuned lodestone to Sylvarya.
You say, "What is the proper method?"
You need to kill wasps and spiders for Wasp Venom Sac and Widow Venom Sac. Hand these to Sylvarya.
She hands you Searing Solution.
Go back to the moss circle and, with the solution on your cursor, /pour solution.
After about 10 seconds Muleda Murktoe will spawn. He is a level 13 Druid and casts Lesser Heal, Burning Embers, and Moon Ember.
Kill Muleda and loot Reekbog Focus.
Stand close to the moss circle and, with the Attuned Lodestone on your cursor, /place lodestone.
You receive Used Lodestone. After 10 seconds you'll be teleported to Shallow Shoals as part of the moss gate collapsing.
Return the Used Lodestone and Reekbog Focus to Sylvarya.
She hands you Druidic Token.
Hand the Druidic Token and Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper to the Commander.
She hands you Icon of the Gatekeeper.

lines.text: 1. Ring the bell and take the lift up and make your way to the 'Upper Tier'.
You can find Sylvarya Starveil in the un-named half house on the 'Upper Tier'
Hand Rolled Leafscroll to Sylvarya Starveil.
I am delighted to be the first to welcome you into the Sentinel's Gaze.
You have been summoned here by our leader, Elydris, because of your promising connection with the spirits of nature. Are you prepared to take the first steps toward becoming a gatekeeper?
im prepared to take the first steps
As a gatekeeper of the Wyrdguard, your role will be to both support and transport your allies through the Wyrdgates.
You will find one such gateway here in Evershade Weald, at the base of the northernmost lift that leads toward the caverns inhabited by fae.
Your first task will be to help nourish and maintain this gateway. Pour the contents of the phial I gave you into the very center of the circular formation of toadstools that you find there.
Once you have poured an offering from the phial, you must then exhibit a moment of patience as you await... a response.

2. take the lift down at the neighboring platform from where you speak to Sylvarya (Note: guard Galen is standing by the lift; this is not the newbie lift you start at. It is marked as the Pixie Lift on the Faelindral map), and stand in the center of the circle of toadstools
3. /take water (while holding the Empty Phial)
4. take the lift back up and return to Sylvarya Starveil.
give the Strange Reaction Phial to Sylvarya Starveil.
You receive Novice Icon of the Gatekeeper.

I thank you for this, CynderR. We must always be vigilant in our efforts regarding the Wyrdgates, for though they are undoubtedly a great asset to our people, they could also prove to be a great vulnerability if left unchecked.
I cannot yet explain the results of your efforts to you, but you have at least taken the first step toward becoming a gatekeeper.
Only one who is capable of viewing the Wyrding could have seen this reaction take place, and thus I present to you this icon to symbolize your rank as a novice.
I would also have you sent on another task, should you choose to accept it.
You say, "what task"
Maintaining the Wyrdgates is our primary responsibility, but it is also our duty to protect our fellow Wyrdguard from any who would see them harm.
As gatekeepers, we are the ones who bring them into the fray, embolden them through our magics, mend their wounds, and call upon nature's own wrath to lash out against those who oppose us.

Take the phial that you filled earlier to an ally of ours in the Preservers, Sylwine Brightspirit is a brilliant alchemist who currently heads the Well of Order, and she may have some insight as to what it now contains,
Head to the Well of Order, Sylwine Brightspirit is in the front room on the way to the 'Lower Tier'.
Hand Strange Reaction Phial to Sylwine Brightspirit.
From the High Gatekeeper herself? Well, I'd best take a look right away!
Ah, from the looks of that symbol, you're a novice among the gatekeepers. Would you be willing to do me a small favor while I look over the phial?
You say, "what favor"
The shop is running a little low on some of the more popular reagents. Normally, I have Preservers running around doing this for me, but you have some free time, right?
I need you to find me two royal jellies, two bat wings, and... maybe a couple of bone chips, just in case.
You can put them all in that reagent bag and secure it once you're done. I should have this phial sorted out by the time you return. Thanks in advance!
Kill a black bat for Bat Wing, a wasp drone for Royal Jelly and a rotting skeleton for Bone Chips.
Combine two Royal Jelly, two Bat Wing, and two Bone Chips in the Reagent Bag.
Hand Full Reagent Bag to Sylwine Brightspirit.
Oh, great, you're back! I thought you might have been that awful rogue who just dropped off a horrible-smelling concoction for me to sort through.
These are fine specimens... and all neatly organized as well! You have my thanks, and, I hope, some answers for your High Gatekeeper.
I put all my findings into that note, but I had to use most of the substance to get any clear results. Where did you say you found that stuff, anyway?
Oh never mind, it's not important. I also included a very important reagent as a measure of thanks for your assistance. I think Sylvarya will appreciate it.
Stop by again if you ever need some potions
head back to Sylvarya Starveil and give her the Novice Icon of the Gatekeeper and the Note of Results.
Another task well done. And here you thought they would not succeed.
It appears that Sylwine thought quite highly of your assistance as well. This particular reagent is nigh impossible to find out here in the Weald.
Take this eye and scribe this scroll. You shall be able to call upon the embers that reside in the heart of all faeflies to both sear and hinder your foes.
I have also taken the liberty of enhancing your icon, as you have proven to be quite resourceful. I believe that you will make a wonderful gatekeeper with the proper guidance.
You are now free to explore the Weald for a time, but when you feel you are ready, you may present your icon to Commander Elydris Stormbough as a sign that you have gained my approval,
Hand Aspirant Icon of the Gatekeeper to Commander Elydris Stormbough.
Sylvarya speaks highly of your potential, young Gatekeeper. I am glad to have the chance to meet and introduce myself.

I am Elydris Stormbough, Commander of the Wyrdguard. I have the honor of being a Gatekeeper, much like yourself. Our ability to bring our allies to and from the fields of battle is an invaluable tactic.
It is a tactic that we must ingrain into younger Gatekeepers as soon as possible. Do you believe that you are ready to learn our ways?
Then I entrust the delivery of an important letter to you, aspirant. Return to Sylvarya and tell her that you are ready to see the paths.
You will be guided through the Wyrding itself and witness firsthand what Gatekeepers are capable of.
Once through the paths, you shall deliver the letter to a human woman named Almina. She shall provide you the means of returning to the Weald.
Go now, aspirant, and may the shades of the Weald protect you.
She hands you Druidic Leafscroll
Say to Sylvarya Starveil "I am ready to see the paths"
I and ready to see the paths
The commander must have high hopes if she sent you to see the pathways so soon. So be it.
Allow me to tether your soul to this place, so that you may use it as an anchor point to return to the Weald.
I shall then open a gateway through which you may enter the Wyrding for the first time.
Make sure that you have your letter with you. You are to return any response to me when you arrive back in the Sentinels Gaze.
Let me know when you are prepared.
Sylvarya will bind your soul.
You say, "I am prepared."
Sylvarya will teleport you to the Sungreet Strand Druid ring.
Hand the letter to Almina Weepingwind.
You're an aspirant of the Wyrdguard, yes? I'm Almina of the Circle of Scarce Rains. I welcome you to our grove here in Sungreet Strand.
Our two orders often exchange correspondence within these sacred places, as they are natural waypoints for those who traverse the penumbral paths. Was that your first time? You look a little queasy!
You can bring this letter back to your High Gatekeeper, and that scroll should teach you how to return along the same pathways you used to get here.
Of course, you can always remain here or visit Night Harbor, though the path is quite dangerous being this close to Tel Ekir... so I'd not advise it unless you're confident.
Almina hands you a letter and the Scroll Gate.
Gate to Evershade Weald and hand the letter to Sylvarya.
Welcome home, aspirant! Not many can navigate the paths so easily for their first time, though you seem to have had no such trouble.
In time, you will learn to bring yourself and others through many such gateways. For now, you will only be able to use the ones that you designate for your own soul.
I see you also made contact with the Circle of Scarce Rains. Their current leader was once a resident of Evershade Weald. She would have made a promising Gatekeeper.
While our two groups are venturing very different paths, it always helps to have allies who share a love for the balance and the natural order.
Now then, the commander will be eager to hear of your return. Go to her and show this token as proof that I have received Almina's response.
Sylvarya hands you Druidic Token.
Hand the token to Commander Elydris Stormbough.
How was your first foray through the paths, young one? It will not be long before you are able to carry entire scouting parties through the Wyrding.
That is for a future day, however. For now, we have more pressing matters here at home that require your direct attention.
Our archers are currently out countering the orc spies, while our fighters fend off the warriors that descend from the cliffsides.
It shall be your duty to assist our forces by countering the fell magics they utilize through shamanistic rituals.
Take this satchel and fill it with the broken idols of Fellstone shamans. They attempt to aid their forces from the back lines, but that is where our moonfire can still strike.
I would advise you to seek out fellow Wyrdguard or other adventurers in your efforts. Return to me once you have sufficiently quelled the orcs' supporting ranks.
And do not hesitate to utilize your newfound ability to traverse the Wyrding, should the need arise.
She hands you Vine-Strapped Satchel.
Kill a Fellstone shaman until you have x4 Broken Shaman Idol. Combine those in the satchel and receive Full Vine-Strapped Satchel.
Hand the satchel to Commander Stormbough.
You have performed admirably, young gatekeeper. A force is nothing without proper support, and you have isolated the orcs from theirs.
These idols reek with the stain of the Spirals, even when broken. Bring them to Sylvarya so that she may continue her investigations.
Thank you again, [name]. We shall call upon you again soon, I am sure.
She hands you the satchel. Take it to Sylvarya.
The instruments of orc rituals carry with them a corruption that lingers, even after their destruction.
I will do what I can to cleanse these idols and see if they align with the other elements we have uncovered so far, but you have done well for the Faelewyn today.
Please accept these gloves as a measure of thanks, [name]. One cannot be too careful in the handling of such dangerous idols.
You may continue to aid those of the Weald for now. I will have one final task for you once my investigations have concluded.
She hands you Sap-Stained Gloves.
If you hail her, she will say the follow
Continue to aid those of the Weald until you feel you are ready to learn more of the Wyrding. Upon such a time, return the gloves to me so that I may gauge your progress.
Hand Sap-Stained Gloves to Sylvarya. She will return them.
Your connection to the natural world has grown stronger, aspirant. Verses of your strength sing from you like wind through the reeds.
The gloves are yours to keep, of course, though you will also need this lodestone if you are ready to assist in my investigations.
She hands you Lodestone.
You say, "I am ready to assist."
You have been aiding me from the start, if you were not already aware.
The reaction from the Wyrdgate due to the phial you poured, the study of its contents by Sylwine, as well as the message received from Almina of the Circle of Scarce Rains.
All were related to a theory of mine; and, upon studying the orcish idols that you last brought me, I have finally reached a conclusion.
You say, "What conclusion?"
I can say with confidence that there is a second Wyrdgate located within the Weald. One that is under the control of our enemies.
This may be how a portion of their forces have entered the Weald undetected, and as Gatekeepers, it falls on us to close it.
Will you use your gifts to aid us in this endeavor, aspirant?
You say, "I will use my gifts."
If the orc forces have somehow opened a second gate, it means they have enlisted aid from someone capable of connecting to the Wyrding... a feat their kind is incapable of.
First we must find the location of this gate, after which we must deal with its creator.

I recommend camouflaging yourself with nature's embrace and scouring the areas of Evershade upon which the orcs have made their presence known. Avoid the undead if you choose to do this, as their unnatural gaze can pierce our shrouds.
Search for any signs of a circular formation. It need not be a circle of toadstools such as our own gate. Theirs could be made of flowers, stones, or any other natural phenomenon.
Once located, you are to place the lodestone within the center of the circle to attune it to its last used destination.
Return the attuned lodestone to me once you have done this, and may the shades of the Weald protect you, [name].

Go to the orc valley and make your way to the ramps that lead up from near the spires that spawn skeletons and rabid dogs just near the road out of the zone. Go up the ramp and then turn left. Head to the end of the road on the cliff and you'll see a moss archway drawn onto the cliff face. This is the moss circle.
While standing near the moss circle and with the lodestone on your cursor, /place lodestone.
You receive Attuned Lodestone. ***After about 10 seconds three orcs will spawn - run or Gate.
Hand the attuned lodestone to Sylvarya.
What do you think? Yes. Yes, I believe so as well.
It is as we feared.
Not only is there a second, active Wyrdgate, but this one has made two distinct connections between the mires of the Reekbog and the shadows of the Deep.
It would be unwise to draw a conclusion from that alone, but the fact remains that we must sever this connection if our forces are to have any hope of reclaiming the cliffs.
I entrust this task to you, aspirant, as with your abilities, you should have no trouble temporarily sealing the gateway. You must, however, employ the proper method.
You say, "What is the proper method?"
Any individual could simply tear away the moss, but this would only provide a short respite. The one who created the gate could return to renew it in short order.

What we require is a solution capable of removing the moss completely from the stone and preventing its regrowth. I can create such a solution for you, but I need you to bring me the venom sac of both a wasp and a Mezzatrian widow spider.
You need to kill wasps and spiders for Wasp Venom Sac and Widow Venom Sac. Hand these to Sylvarya.
She hands you Searing Solution.
Here is the solution you require. Pour this upon the moss to destroy it, but be cautious. Such interference with the gateway is sure to spare the ire of the one who created it.
That is the plan, of course. Once you have drawn out the interloper, you must subdue them to prevent them from ever conjuring another Wyrdgate.
Lastly, and most importantly, you must place the attuned lodestone once more into the center of the destroyed gateway to seal off the Wyrding completely.

Return to me with the used lodestone, as well as any evidence of your victory against the orcs' hired hand. Should you require more of the solution, you will have to fetch me another wasp and widow venom sac.
Go back to the moss circle and, with the solution on your cursor, /pour solution.
After about 10 seconds Muleda Murktoe will spawn. He is a level 13 Druid and casts Lesser Heal, Burning Embers, and Moon Ember.
Kill Muleda and loot Reekbog Focus.
Stand close to the moss circle and, with the Attuned Lodestone on your cursor, /place lodestone.
You receive Used Lodestone. After 10 seconds you'll be teleported to Shallow Shoals as part of the moss gate collapsing.
Return the Used Lodestone and Reekbog Focus to Sylvarya.

A druid of the Reekbog was aligned with the orcs? A frightening development, though not entirely surprising. The trolls are notorious survivors, and there could be dozens of reasons as to how they found themselves doing the bidding of the Fellstone Clan.
