lines.text: Give Torn Note to Sinastin Aspenleaf.
Ah yes... welcome to my humble organization. The Lamplighters are honored to add such a...
...wonderful find, such as yourself, to our roster.
The note you just handed me means that, while you may be new, you're already trusted enough to start earning your keep.
The courier I was going to send out today is no longer with us. So, please take list and read the names written therein. Let me know if you have any questions about these people.
Now, show that note to Albrecht on the way out. He'll give you what you need.
Once you have gathered all of our gifts, take the bag to Albrecht to inventory and bring the receipt to me when he's finished.
You are tasked with retrieving items from six NPCs across Night Harbor. Read Sinastin's List of Names and then give it to Albrecht in the next room.
Toss those sealed notes into the bag I gave you and don't try to open them. Nor should you open the packages you get in return. Nosey people don't fare well here.
Well, my new friend. I wish you the best of luck.
I hope you last longer than the last guy.
Oh, and here's your list of names back.
Go and locate the following NPCs and retrieve the requested items.
There are a lot of new faces since my time in the City Watch. Some of them are taking a little longer to warm up to me, but soon I'll have another roster ready to go.
Now drink this and get out of here before anyone gets suspicious.
Well, that contained an interesting enough proposition.
Give this to your master, he'll be happy I got it back in one piece. Make sure it arrives that way.
And, my new friend, here's a drunk for the walk back.
Now piss off.
When you have collected all six items combine them inside the Small Courier Bag. Turn in the combined Small Courier Bag to Albrecht.
One hand. Check. Wait.. is the tattoo..
Oh! There it is. Check.
A bar of gold...
Check.
Umbral transducer. Good to see you again. Check.
Well that means a change of plans, but... guard schedule. Check.
Oh my!
Rubies, Check.
The tower key. Check.
Well, it looks like everything is accounted for. Take the receipt to Sinastin... and keep your mouth shut.
Give the receipt to Sinastin
Well it looks like we've received everything we expected. I trust that everything went smoothly.
I'd like for you to deliver the list to Irfan. You probably saw him on the way in.
If you're unfamiliar with our formidable friend... well, to put it simply, he's an avatar of violence. He may not be as sneaky as some of the others, but he is absolute in his loyalty.
Irfan is not 'sneaky peaky' like you and many others within our organization. Irfan is an avatar of violence. But, he is absolute in his loyalty.
...And loyalty is a good trait to have around here. I'd advise against crossing me.
Off with you, then! You don't want to keep Irfan waiting... he isn't known for his patience.
Give the note to Irfan Raz, located right outside the Illuminators' Guild.
You'll need this, so hang on to it.
Sinastin needs you to do three things for him.
If you are caught by the guards, you'll not speak of this work. If you do, we will know. Understand?
I'll take that as a yes. Bring this parchment to Stumpy at one of his posts in the market. He has the first job for you.
When you're done, return to me my dagger to me, along with proof you have completed the task.

Give Irfan's Parchment to Stumpy the Whistler, standing by the cobbler in the Night Market. He can also be in the left stall when entering Night Market from the west bank. Rumor is he roams at times. Be sure to look around the bridge to Twilight Harbor as you leave the South East corner of Night Market.
Give the Piece of Parchment to Sproggets Bedsprings, located in the shop next to the northwest entrance to the Night Market.
Okay, I'll give you the goods. But you didn't get it from me.
I'm neutral in all of this... just an innocent gnome trying to earn some coin.
Do you even know how to use this thing? Look for a good place to climb, throw the grappling hook, then climb. That's all there is to it. Look, throw, and away you go.
Now, out with ya! ...But maybe bring it back when you're done with it.
Go to the Steel Talons Garrison onto the roof of the southern structure overlooking the west gate newbie yard. There is a small tower-like section with no roof.
Give the Haradrel's Bloodstone Eye and Irfan's Dagger to Irfan Raz.
Let's hope you didn't just catch notice of the God of War.
For your next job, pay a visit to Whispering Wallace at the Shaded Bloom Inn. He'll be drinking there at night. Show him my dagger so he knows I sent you.
And like before, return with my dagger and proof of your deed.
Give Irfan's Dagger to Whispering Wallace.
I've gathered word that Pasha Patrice has a special guest at her compound. The guest is an emissary from Tarellon who's travelling through Night Harbor under Patrice's protection.
Let's just say it would be very embarrassing to her and her operation if this guest winds up dead.
They've given the emissary a room for the night on the second floor of the compound, just past the room where our fake 'Pasha' likes to hold court toward the end of the day.
You're new, so you may not know about the compound. It's in the eastern corner of the market. On the right as you're leaving, just before the bridge. Sometimes Stumpy posts up across from it.
The boss is pissed that she set up shop so close to us, so he'll be happy when you pull this off.
You'll probably want this dagger back. When the job's done, return it to Irfan with proof of the deed.
Good hunting.

Go to the compound described to survey the area and plan your attack. On the west side of the building, you will see a fountain. The attack must happen at night ( between 3a.m. and 6a.m.) when the emissary is in her room. You will need to jump across from a nearby 2nd floor building to get access. You can get on top of the city wall from behind the bathhouse. Run on the wall towards Night Market. When you see the fountain on your left, the building you're looking for will be next. Jump down from the wall on to the closest building. Jump the gap over to the 2nd floor of the Claw Compound. Find the emissary's room behind a closed door. Kill an emissary and loot her Fine Leather Courier Bag and return it along with the dagger to Irfan Raz.
The last job is from me. There's a camp of smugglers along the coast to the west of here.
You'll find a man named Toma there. He's in charge. He needs to die. I want the ring he wears as proof.
You might find this handy once again.
You got the rat man's ring! His death will show the rest of Vermahn's crew whose territory they're in... not that his thrall has much choice in the matter.
Take these to our little bookkeeper upstairs.
Don't neglect to slide him my dagger... point first.
So he knows I sent you.
You can have this one back. I don't know where he finds all of them...
You can never be too careful with defiling the likeness of a god.
Well, several people will be upset to see the emissary dead... including our little pretend Pasha. But that's her problem to deal with now.
Good work. She's almost as hideous as some other people I know.
Filthy business, this lot. Like a nest of vipers and rats, constantly biting each other.
Well, here you are. Take this receipt to Sinastin.
You seem decent enough. Take this note to Elmswood at the Spirit Tap. If I'm not wrong about you, you might want to hear what he's got to say. If I'm wrong, we never spoke.
Wrap things up with Sinastin first, then go to the Spirit Tasp before you do anything more for him. You'll understand more when you speak to Elmswood.
Very well done. I see you brought back one of the rat's rings, too.
Did you keep the finger you found it on? ...Actually, never mind that. Here's a nicer ring for your troubles. It would seem that you're a Lamplighter after all.
Which means... I've got another job for you. Take this bag. There are a few things I'd like you to retrieve for me.
What things?

The tomb just outside of town is said to contain a wealth of interesting artifacts. I've learned that one of our rivals, Jamee Langris, is attempting to recover an amulet for a client of his. It supposedly allows the wearer to commune with spirits.
The previous amulet bearer entered the tomb to speak with a certain female spirit... but she put a quick end to him. Find her, and I bet you'll find the amulet.
The other thing I need can be found at the archaeological site in Shaded Dunes. I'm very curious about the activities of the head researcher there... a fellow named Aashir.
Sneak into the site after dark and see if you can find his documentation. He's bound to have a journal or something similar to log their findings.
On that note, I've heard that a group of cultists has been poking around there lately. Don't let them get to it first.
Place both items in the bag and bring it directly to me. Don't involve Albrecht this time.
Well then... the dwarf has finally gathered some courage.
But... if you're interested in running with a less 'despicable' crew, then take this note to the fishing camp just outside the city. Someone will meet you there at midnight.
Elmswood said he was sending someone... and the note is real enough.
We run with Tinka Roofstrider's crew. She despises Sinastin, so the bag he gave you and the items he wanted in it... we want them.
That pointy dung pile of an elf won't be too pleased if you do this for us, so you'd better think carefully about it.

If you choose to run with us, you'll have a bounty on your head as well... and I'm sure you've seen what Irfan and the other Lamplighters are capable of. Hells, you've likely had to do some of it yourself.
So, ask your questions now. If you decide to move forward with us, fetch the items and bring me the bag.
You know when and where to find me.
Combine both the completed Aashir's Journal and the Engraved Amulet into the Black Leather Courier Bag and it'll turn into a completed Black Leather Courier Bag.
Fantastic Work.
This will certanly leave Langris in a bind. It's not often that he fails to fulfill a request... pity.
As for the journal, I look forward to seeing what opportunities it has for us.
For now, take some time off. You've earned it, and... you've pleased me.
Alternate Hand combined black leather bag to Selyst Surecoin.
Well, well... for better or worse, it looks like you've got a new crew to meet! We've got a couple of safehouses in the Bends.
Sure, it's a little dangerous there for outsiders, but it's fun once you know your way around.
Take the bag to Tinka. She'll be expecting you. You'll find her observing the courtyard, just inside the main gate to Riverbend.
Oh, and just so you know, you made the right choice.
Take Black Leather Courier Bag to Tinka Roofstrider.
We were hoping you'd make the right choice. Welcome to the crew!
I'll have something you can help with soon. In the meantime, if Sinastin gave you one of his gaudy rings, hand it over and we'll give you something classy.
Otherwise, feel free to poke around and meet the crew.
Hand Tinka Roofstrider Lamplighter's Ring
Yep, that's the one. Trashy, isn't it?
Here, this is much better.

Night Harbor is far more than what shows on her surface. You'll see in due time and we'll learn the durability of your resolve.
Take your note to Brazzic, downstairs in the sleeping quarters. He'll get you started.
You receive Weathered Note from Exavius Deathwhisper.

... and if you think I mean your tongue, my response will be painful.
Give Weathered Note Note to Brazzic Durraim who is also in the Concourse of Souls.
Well, you made it. Our people have been watching you. Appears you're more "knight" than "shadow" for the time being. And to be fair, friend, you don't look like much of a knight.
But at least you arrived, and I guess that counts for something.
We're going to get straight to business. Let's see how you operate.
Deliver the note to a gentleman named Noel Klares. Bring back whatever he gives you.
The bag is to be filled with shattered femurs from the bone piles you saw stumbling around out in the desert. Do you have questions?

Go out into the yard in front of the Concourse of Souls and hunt a rotting skeleton until you have 6 Shattered Skeleton Femur. Combine them inside the Black Leather Bag from Brazzic and receive a Bag of Femurs.

Locate Noel Klares in the Wayfarers Hospice in Night Harbor and give him the Sealed Scroll. (find guard tower, go up, back inside 2nd floor, find ramp, go up, he's on the roof). *** Warning. The guards will assist him if they are nearby. It is recommended to pull him to a safer area where guards will not patrol.
You've come to confront me? Don't you know who I work for?
... they ... they will ... find you.
Return to Brazzic Durraim and give him Bag of Femurs and Noel Klares' Ring.
Bravo! Our people say you performed well. And the fact that you're here now and not locked in prison, means that you've got a bit of a shadow to your knight after all.
Feels good to do bad things to bad people sometimes, eh?
As master Hallows was kind enough to establish this wonderful college from which we now operate, we in return, provide services to his necromancers and faculty.
Please take the bag over to Buckmarr Gorstagg, the head alchemist. He'll make use of it's contents.
Your next task will involve his favorite abomination. Return to me after you've assisted him with it. Then, maybe you can take a little break and peruse some of this fair city's night life.
Hail Buckmarr Gorstagg.

lines.text: You shall take what remains of those who were scorned and have them reveal the source of the wolves' agony. Can you hear their cries?
I cannot hear their cries.
The mournful howls of the Weald's wolves haunt my dreams of late. More of their number fall to savagery and madness by the day.
I have altered the bone dust that you collected, so that it may cling to the dismal agonies of woeful spirits.
There is a wolf pack amongst the western cliffs whose cries concern me most. Locate and scatter the dust at the entrance of their den to reveal the source of this dismay.
Throw, or simply pour out the contents of the pouch. It should make no difference. Once revealed, you must confront the spirit and, if need be, cleanse it. Do you understand?
I understand.
Learn from the scroll I have given you to conceal yourself from the gaze of any wolves who have fallen to madness.
Return to me with anything that you uncover, along with your novice hoop. You may also return and ask me for more dust, should you lose what you have.
So the fae have had a hand in this? Their antics grow bolder by the day, despite our tenuous agreement.
You were not wrong to mete out punishment for the imbalance they caused. I would say you deserve this.
Well done Listener. Though now we must see about this strange toadstool. Perhaps it can tell us a clue.
What clue?
Tell me, young Listener, do you hear the whispers?
What whispers?
I believe you will be capable of hearing a great many things before long, young one. Not just from toadstools, but from all manner of objects in which the spirits reside.
Even from objects that have been with you from the near beginning. Please, allow me to see your apprentice hoop so that I may listen to all it has experienced in your journey thus far.
An interesting journey you have taken to get here. Your hoop is excited to experience more, so I shall return it to you. Be sure to hold onto it so it can take in more of your continued story.
You will also need to bring this toadstool with you for your next task. We are now being whispered toward a group who lives reclusively among the roots of Faelindral.
Tell me, young Listener, do you know of the Circle of Spores?
What circle of spores?

They are a cloistered cult of druids who have a strong connection to fungus and mushrooms. If there are any within the Weal who would be able to tell us the source of this strange toadstool, it would be them.
I have safely packed the toadstool within the box I provided you. Deliver it to a member of the Circle of Spores, who seclude themselves beneath Faelindral in Sporehave Karts.
I know not the name of the particular druid who may be able to help us, but the Circle are not unwelcoming of guests. Their experiments on the other hand...
You should be strong enough to call upon the spirits to conceal yourself. If the Circle's experiments have gone awry, as they are known to, it may be prudent to learn such a spell before departing.
Spirits watch over you, young Listener.
BEWARE A NUMBER OF SPORELINGS PATH RIGHT PAST THE NPC, DO NOT RISK CONVERSATION WITHOUT INVIS/HIDE HANDY!!!
Hmm... this is quite the interesting specimen that you have brought me, shaman. I can tell at a glance that is has been manipulated by a magical force, not unlike our own myconids.
Though I could not tell you much more without a thorough examination. Perhaps we could come to an agreement?
What agreement?
I am looking to produce a new strain of fungus that is far more robust than previous generations.
To further my research, I need some components from out in the Weald. If you can gather them for me, I will look further into the origins of this toadstool for you.
Does that sound acceptable?
It is acceptable.
Then we have an agreement. You can use the empty box that you brought the toadstool in as a container. It seems sturdy enough.
All I require are the scales of green drakelings, along with some wax from wasp workers. Five of each should suffice for my needs.
By the time you return with the box filled and sealed, I should have some more answers for you regarding this mysterious toadstool.
You return at a most fortuitous moment, young shaman. I have just finished my examination of the toadstool and I must say, the results are quite intriguing.
You also have my gratitude for your efforts in procuring these components. Drake scales and wax are notoriously resistant to fungus, which shall aid my endeavors to strengthen our strains.
Though I imagine you must be curious to hear the results?
What results?
The toadstool by itself is not so significant; rather, it is the odd hex that seems to be afflicting all of its contained moisture.
This hexed moisture makes its way into the numerous spores released by the toadstool, and once a great number of these spores are taken into the lungs... well...
The victim is afflicted with a terrible malady that assaults the mind directly, causing hallucinations, emotional strain, and potentially even madness.

I daresay that whoever conjured such a hex has a sinister imagination. Though, it would appear the moisture is the key to all this, as it is what drips with malice. A malice that feels all too familiar to me...
I hope this was as much help to you as your efforts were to the Circle of Spores. Thank you once more, friend.
Your return was whispered to me, young Listener. As was the conversation you had with the Sporeweaver.
It seems that moisture is the key to what has been ailing the great bears, yes? If our clues are to be the fae and moisture, then there is only one possible direction to look toward next.
Though that direction must wait for now. I must confer with the spirits on this matter, but you have the thanks of the forest, along with my own, for all that you have uncovered.
Take this headdress so that you might be protected from any intrusions into your own mind. It may prove useful, should this path lead us toward those capable of causing madness and grief.

When you feel you are ready to confront this threat to the Weald, bring me your apprentice hoop while donning the spirit-blessed headdress. I would hear from them both to gauge your capabilities regarding our next task.
It appears you have more to learn before I can entrust you with your next task, young Listender.
Return and present me your hoop once you have learned how to effectively dispel harmful magics, and the next task is yours.
What next task?
As you already know, spirits of the Weald are succumbing to a terrible malady of the mind.

From the myconid creatures of the Circle of Spores to the bestial spirits of the great wolf packs, it seems any who settle themselves close to the banks of the river are prone to bouts of inexplicable madness.
This, I believe, is being perpetrated by the naiads of the Whispering Pools.
What Whispering Pools?
The naiads have long since been bound to the Whispering Pools. They are forbidden from leaving, due to a pact with the Queen of the Winter Court herself.
Though being bound does not mean the naiads are without their own ambitions.
Many of them yearn to be free of the Whispering Pools, and this latest act of whimsy is likely an attempt to expand their means without breaking the terms of their pact.
If we are to do something to counteract the ploys of the naiads, we must first understand what sort of enchantments they are dispersing into the Weald's waters.
I advise you to seek out Laenyth Windharp of the Lambent Wanderers. She is their tale keeper, and the bards are known to study and even conduct performances that mimic the alluring call of a siren.

If any in Faelindral would know of water nymph enchantments, it would be them. Show her your hoop to present yourself as a Preserver, then glean what you can about the magics of the naiads. Return to me with anything you manage to uncover.
Ah, to what do I owe the pleasure of this visit, apprentice? I'm fond of Listeners joining me for a tale. You lot are remarkably attentive to our stories.
Is there anything in particular that you wish to hear about?
Naiads.
The naiads? I'm quite familiar with their tale, as young bards are often stricken by their songs... competitively or otherwise.
They're a beautiful people, if not prone to wickedness and uncaring whimsy. Their songs can flow as gently as a stream or crash with the cacophonous roar of a waterfall, as befits their mood.
Do you wish to hear what's known of their Mistress Naelira, or are you more interested in their siren's song?
What siren's song?

The siren's call... it's a popular and powerful technique capable of fully capturing a person's attention. They're also prone to suggestion while captivated, turning a once alluring song into a dangerous one if used with ill intent.

Many of the faerie courts are impressive singers in their own right, though the naiads' sirens occupy a league of their own. Did you know a voice can carry over great distances when delivered across a span of calm water?
The sirens utilize their affinity with water to naturally enhance their own voices, so a mere conversation can cause one to become enraptured if they're not careful.

Some also believe the naiad sirens are capable of singing into the currents of flowing water, so their voices can reach those downstream. I personally don't believe such a thing is possible... unless you believe the old rumors.
What old rumors?
The naiads have remarkable voices, though even with their affinity for water, they cannot sing with their full cadence while submerged in the very pools they call home.
A voice, no matter how strong, would be drowned out by the flow of a river as it crashes against the banks and weaves its way through rock and reed.
However, there were rumors of a technique one could use to protect a song on its journey through a perilous river. Something to enshroud it is a pocket of air, such as... a bubble or river foam.
I've made notes on such a theory before. Now where did I...
Ah, here they are! These notes cover the methods one might use to enhance a siren's call. You're more than welcome to them, should the Perservers have use of my old theories.
I see that you do not return empty-handed, young Listener. Let us see what knowledge Laenyth has documented regarding the magic of naiads...
Voices carried through bubbles or foam... quite curious, indeed. Could the naiads be sending their very voices through the currents of the river using this method?
You must investigate this for us, . Your talents should allow you the means to sense magical influences upon the world, if you have studied your scrolls.
I bid you venture out to the very end of the river, furthest from the Whispering Pools, to the crest of the mighty waterfall that spills out into the Twilight Sea.

Use your spell to sense magical flows and determine whether the naiads' enchantments have extended so far out from their domain. Should you discover enchanments at the falls, take a sample of the water using this flask and return it to me.
/inspect water
/take water
A curious thing, this sample you have brought me. Even while contained, I can hear the intrusive melodies that are bound within.
This is a disturbing revelation. If the naiads have somehow found a way to carry their voices down the span of the entire river, it threatens the very balance of the Weald.
We must take action to purge this enchantment before more minds are drawn into madness.
Take this sigil. young Listener. You will need it to fashion a totem that can be used to cleanse the waters of the naiad's influence. It is but one component of this specific recipe.
What recipe?
To fashion the totem, you will need to acquire some fine wood for the base. Four timber should be enough. If you have a talent for logging, you may find some in Keeper's Blight.
While in the Blight, you will also need the skins of four serpents that roam the fields. The serpent's flesh is well suited for warding away moisture.
Lastly, you will need something from the river water that is both born from it, but also immune to a siren's song. I believe Selstie Kelp will serve the purpose well.
Worry not if you are unskilled with such labors, the totem need not be a masterpiece. Return to me with your crafted totem, and I shall guide you further.
Take this totem to the top of the falls, which cascade over the Whispering Pools the water nymphs call their home.
Invoke the totem's powers to purge the waters of the enchantment. But be warned, the naiads will not appreciate us denying them their amusement.
If you are challenged, then do what you must to restore balance to the Weald. Should your totem lose its potency, return it to me and I will do my best to empower it once more.
Spirits watch over you, young Listener.
You will not defile our waters with your horrid magics, mortal! Our voices shall spread across all rivers, in the name of Mistress Naelira!!
H-how could you... a mere mortal...
It seems that you have had to confront a particularly vile spirit, young Listener. Your efforts are already being felt throughout the Weald.
Return to me the expended totem, the coldstone, and your apprentice hoop. I would hear all three of their tales of your triumph this day.
It appears that this Delugia Coldsong was driven by a desire to appease her Mistress Naelira. So much so, that she would risk breaking the pact they made with the fae courts.

These markings are typical for ashira leather. What's made you curious about it, friend?
Ashira are known to shapeshift into jackals, their animal form, so to speak, which is probably how you came by it.
You seem surprised. Don't believe old me? Show the pelt to a seasoned bard, they can tell you more tales about the ashira folk.
Or if you don't want it, we'll take it off of your hands for a few copper. They're tough and make for a solid base to work with!
An ashira's pelt? Mayhaps you could tell me why you're showing me this?
I wish to learn more about the tales of the ashira folk.
The ashira are a race of jackalweres, indigenous to the deserts and foothills of southwestern Aêthoril. They've inhabited these dunes long before us, wanderer.
They live harmoniously with nature and loathe the unnatural. In times past, our kin were both at war with and friendly to each other.
A shame, truly. Their race is as ancient as the stars themselves, and their abilities are equally extraordinary.
What abilities?

Oh yes... the ashira have mastered the mystical art of shapeshifting. It was bestowed upon them through the Yowling, a spiritual heritage passed down from their revered ancestors. With a whisper to the wind and a call to the wild, the ashira can transform, taking the form of jackals or even... that of a human.

Rumors abound of ashira hiding their true form beneath a veneer of human flesh, weaving through the throngs of cityfolk... even here in Night Harbor. So perfect is their mimicry that one might never know the person beside them is not of human kin.

But heed this tale well, for the Yowling is no mere parlor trick, It's the echo of their lineage, a bond with the primeval forces that crafted the very essence of our world. To witness an ashira shift is to gaze upon the ancient dance of spirit and flesh, a secret rite as old as time itself.
As keepers of this world's ancient tales, some bards hold the secret of a rare chant learned from times of mistrust, one that forces an ashira back to their true form.
Alas, the chant is not known to me, only to the most gifted of bards. My muse and lifelong partner, Alisar, was one of them.
Who was Alisar?
Alisar was a wonderful musician and storyteller. Many moons ago, I couldn't help but fall deeply in love with his beautiful soul. We wed not long after and voyaged across the continent together.
Unfortunately... he is no longer with us. He took his instruments and musical sheets with him to the grave.
His last voyage took him to the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane. He fought alongside his companions to recover a unique pipe organ that had been lost deep below the sands.
I've never heard, nor seen him again since...
If you dare tread the cursed halls of the tomb to reclaim Alisar's belongings, I'll be in your eternal debt. IF the chant you seek is among them, I'll teach it to you as payment.
You... have returned from the shadowed depths of the tomb, bearing treasures long mourned as lost...

In these strings and parchment, the spirit of Alisar Noor dances once more. You've brought back more than just keepsakes, you've restored the echoes of a love that time itself could not silence. Thank you, kind adventurer.
Listen closely playername.
This is the chant you seek. I'll transcribe the words onto parchment for you. Recite them faithfully to activate its intended use... but use it with the utmost care.
A word of warning... I don't know how the ashira will react if you disrupt their shapeshifting. Be careful.
Hail, Mayana.
What have you done, biped?! My form...
State your intent, quickly! are you friend or foe?!
I am a friend.
You would keep my identity a secret? Why?
It is unexpected... but I cannot deny this show of trust.
Please, take this as a token of our mutual understanding.
I cannot leave the city due to... obligations. My pack is at great risk, both from folk in Night Harbor and within our home in Tel Ekir.
Will you assist us where we suffer most?
Yes, I will assist you.
Those crazed goblins who call themselves the bloodynose clan have invaded our home in Tel Ekir. They only seek to slaughter us and summon the unnatural.
Please... help us protect the Life Font and drive them out. It would ease our spirits' burden.
If you do this, bring me any goblin ear (Bloodynose Goblin Ear) and heads (Bloodynose Goblin Head) you take. The pack will reward you for proving your worth to us.
And be sure to wear the ring when you bring them to me, so that I may see your conviction to our cause.
The pack cannot thankyou enough. This will give our young ones much-needed respite.
you Honour the pack.
A most urgent matter has reached my ears. Will you lend us a hand once more?
Fallen Pass is home to the wretched. These monsters are poisoning our lands and need to be stopped.
put an end to their evil deeds. We would be eternally indebted to you.

Hail, Tig Pebblebank.
No, Mr. Brookturner. Give me a moment and I'll help you look for it.
What? Oh! Hi there. I'm Lead Measurer Tig Pebblebank.
I'm sorry about all that. We've been really behind lately with all the delays.
Delays?
Don't get me started. The foreman should have secured the site, and our camp should have been set up days ago.
Safety is a high priority for us, we must be allowed to do our delicate work unhindered!
Now, I must check our equipment and send word to the Church of Trem about what's missing. Someone else will have to take the measurements... there's just too much to do.
Measurements?
Part of our charter as representatives of the Measure is to map an exact layout of the quarry. It's a complicated process to complete, but it starts off simple enough.
First we find the surface area of the plot for the purchase records, then we measure the overall volume to determine how much stone has already been excavated.
If I weren't so busy, I'd make these measurements myself, but...
If only I had an apprentice...
Apprentice
You're interested? I could field commission you as an apprentice in service of the Measure. It would be an official errand!
There's one condition though... it would require you to take an oath. Are you willing?
If so, I'll swear you in and you can get started immediately. You'll be paid, of course, as befitting a junior member of the Measure.
I am willing
Good! Then place your hand over your coin purse. Yes, just like so.
Do you, by the stars that guide us and the sands beneath our feet, under the watchful eye of Trem, god of trade and tradesmen alike, pledge your time and work to the Guild of the Measure?
Do you promise to chart the unknown with clarity and precision, mark the borders, and endeavor to uncover the secrets of the land?
Do you vow to uphold the truth in all your measurements, honor the trust placed in you, and serve with diligence and integrity?

Do you swear, as long as the sun rises and sets, and by the grace of Trem, to remain steadfast and true, to become a beacon of knowledge, and a protective curator of all tools loaned to you for an assigned task?
This is the part where you say I do.
I do
With this oath, I bind your spirit to the Measure and the service of Trem, for now and forever, until the terms of your commission have ended.
This disk represents your apprenticeship with the Measure. You'll make good use of it, I'm sure.
Alright then, that's settled. For your task, I have just about everything you need, with the exception of rope.
Go to Night Harbor and visit the Night Market. There's a general store there owned by Sproggets Bedsprings. Tell him I sent you.
We need ten hemp ropes at fifty length each. He should have it in stock. Bring me the ropes and we'll get started.
Heyo! Looking to get into some adventuring? Take a look at my wares.
Tig sent me
Oh she did, did she? What does she want this time?
Rope
Rope you say. Well, I do have rope for sale, but I'm guessing you're seeking the Guild of the Measurer's standard discount.
Fine. Two silver coin and you can have ten ropes of fifty length. I'll even throw in a small field pack to carry them in.
Just give me the coin when you're ready. I'll set them aside until you return.
Good doing business with you! May Trem's fortune find you.
Excellent! Let me prepare the rope for you.
Here you go. One knotted rope at about five hundred length. This should be long enough to do the job.
Now, make some room in your pack because there's quite a few items you'll need for the task. Let me know when you're ready!
I am ready
Good! Here's the survey form to fill out. Use your apprentice disk to mark down any measurements you've taken.
Also, this is a surveying book written by yours truly. You'll find it useful.
And here's an advanced book on surveying.
I know this is a lot of information, but I believe in you. You're also the only one who can do this right now... so there's that too. In Trem we trust, as I guess we must!
For your first task, you'll need to find the surface area of the quarry. The books cover this, so I wont bore you with the details.
Seek out the markers at the quarry. They've got bright green cloths on them so they should be easy to see, but you might need to take a closer look to see the numbers on them.
Look for marker number one. Secure one end of the rope there, then stretch it all the way to marker two.
Take the first measurement and bring it back to me to check your work.
Where's the knotted rope? Did you know that you left some rope attached to a marker?
You must untie the rope from the marker and bring it back with you.
Go ahead. I'll be here when you return.
This is a good start. You just need one more measurement and we'll have what we need to figure out the area.
Now, go back to marker two and get the length from marker two to marker three. Once you've written down the length, bring the survey back to me to check.
Great! You have the measurements needed for the area. Now, we need to get the measurement for the volume.
Go find markers four and five and measure the distance between them. After you've written down the length, bring the survey back to me to look over.
After this measurement, you won't need the rope anymore. Hand that in too when you're done.
Great! You have the measurements needed for the area. Now, we need to get the measurement for the volume.
Go find markers four and five and measure the distance between them. After you've written down the length, bring the survey back to me to look over.
After this measurement, you won't need the rope anymore. Hand that in too when you're done.
You have the lengths! Great! I hope it wasn't too difficult.
Now, all I need to do on my end is verify the form. The results are, honestly, as I expected.
We're not done though. The surface area needs to be added to the form. Based on your measurements, I know what the area is... but do you?
Consider this a test of your skill, apprentice. Think carefully about the answer and take your time to get it right. Once you've got it, tell me your answer.
Or, if you just want to be done with the survey, you can hand me the form and go.
Well done, that's correct!
If you don't mind, I'll jot that down on your form.
There, now you have the area of the quarry filled in.
I must say, I'm impressed with your skill so far. Advanced surveying concepts don't come easily.
I wonder... do you happen to know the last measurement, the volume of the quarry? Tell me, and we can finish this form properly.
Once again, this is quite an advanced surveying technique. If it's too much for you, you can hand me the form and go. I'll understand.
Trem's fortune favors you, my apprentice! That is correct!
Hand me the survey. Let us put an end to this task.
This will be a great help to not only the Measure, but also to Trem's faithful.
Please take this as thanks for your efforts. Rest well, knowing you've served a higher purpose this day. Trust in Trem.

Our illustrious head doctore is none other than Jabir Il-hamar, Doctore of the School of Elemental Mastery. He can be found atop our tower, looking out over the city when he is not busy in his office.
Next is the Doctore of the School of Celestial Investigation, Adimah Starseeker. She typically works in the orrery, but if she is not there, she may be out doing her research.

Doctore Rallin Wizzentrop is the head of the School of Aberration Research. He can usually be found within the tower itself, accompanied by his wonderful dragon companion. Though we haven't been seeing much of the latter lately, he often sends the creature out on errands.

Doctore Veygen Antorious can be found within the tower. This maverick of the School of Aethernautical Exploration often has his head in the clouds, but that is not a bad thing. He is a skilled airship pilot and even possesses the power to travel to other planes. His ability is not to be taken lightly.

Finally, you can find Doctore Lanna Invintoria in the Grand Library. She was originally an honored guest from Calafrey, but she decided to join our school! She teaches Humanoid Studies and is a skilled linguist, anthropologist, and historian.
And those are the wonderful heads of our five schools.
Head up the tower and hand your Academy Prospectus to Veygen Antorious
Hmm...

Yes, I think you'll do. Allow me to sign your form, but know that I expect great things from you—as I do from every prospective student of the Academy. You're a little older than some of the other novices, but I expect you'll catch up in your studies quickly.
I suppose congratulations are in order. Let's hope that the other faculty heards are in agreement with my choice.
Head further up the tower and hand your Academy Prospectus to Jabir Il-hamar
Ah, I see. A new student wishes to enroll in our illustrious Academy.
Jabir Il-hamars ays,
Do not make me regret allowing you into this Academy.
Hold.
Ah, so you wish to join our academy.
Bring this to my adjunct, Domas. You can find him tending to the orrery. He should return my prized quill to you. Bring it back to me, and I will sign your prospectus.
Ah, I see you've spoken with my mother. Very well... I take it she wants her quill back, yes? She left it in one of the other notebooks she gave me, you see. She tends to use them as bookmarks.
Well, here's the quill. Hopefully, she'll be happy with it. And tell her to get some rest; she's always staying up too late.
Hold.
Ah, my quill. Wonderful.
Hm, Domas cleaned it for me. I should reward him for that.
Ah, right! Your prospectus! Here you are.
Now, if you'll excuse me, I have a lot more work to do.
Head back to the tower and hand your Academy Prospectus to Rallin Wizzentrop
Yes, yes, a work order... Tell Hamsar I've already completed his special item.
Head back to the library and hand the Delivery for Hamsar to Hamsar
Oh, I see. Ya brought this from Rallin. Wonderful! I’ve been waiting all month fer him to fix this fer me.
Oh, he kept yer prospectus? That’s unfortunate fer ya… I’ll make sure t’write something on this here receipt.
Good luck, newbie!
Return to Rallin Wizzentrop and hand him Hamsar's Receipt
Ah, very well, you wish to study at our Academy?

I will sign your prospectus, but I require proof of your arcane prowess. Bring me two snake skins. I require their use in one of my experiments. Any snake you find around Night Harbor will do. Do this, and I will provide you with a signature.
Wonderful, wonderful, they are in fine condition. Yes, this will do. Very well, here is your signed prospectus, as promised.
Combine all 5 notes in to the Academy Folio as well as the original Academy Prospectus to receive the Complete Academy Prospectus.
Ah, splendid! I take it you had no difficulty receiving signatures from our illustrious staff?
Please, , take this to our headmaster. I am sure you know who he is by now, he did have to sign one of your forms after all. Do not tarry!
Head up the tower to Jabir Il-hamar and hand him the Approved Academy Prospectus.
Very well. It’s all here, it seems. Your diligence has paid off, for you are now a Grade 0 Student at the Chartered Academy of Arcane Inquiry.
Wear it with pride, . Now, go and practice your magic. Once you have learned a few more spells, return to me, wearing your robes, and I will offer you your first assignment.
I'm afraid I have bad news. A few days ago, one of your fellow students was sent to the Tomb of the Last Wyrmsbane... but he has yet to return.
Viridon is his name... he's an experienced student.
Please go out there, find him, and bring him back to us safely. It's advisable that you take companions with you.
Turn in Scorched Academy Folio to Jabir Il-hamar.
A folio from our academy? Why are you...
No, this cannot be! Are you telling me this belonged to Viridon?
This is dreadful news! I hope no ill has befallen him. We must investigate... will you help me?
Thank you, player
Please bring Viridon's folio to Liyna in the Grand Library. She'll analyze it and help us find a lead. Go at once!
Turn in Scorched Academy Folio to Liyna Esueiruc.
A folio? I'm not one of the Academy's Doctores.
Turn in Scorched Academy Folio to Liyna Esueiruc.
There's odd traces of runic charring on this. It looks like whomever was carrying it was hit by a necromantic spell.
You've done well to stay out of trouble. Ask Jabir for a just reward.
I still need more time to investigate, but when you see Jabir, please hand him this message from me.
We'll speak again, student. Fear not, we'll get to the bottom of this.
Yes... right... of course.
Student... thank you... We'll investigate your findings. Please do not worry yourself with it any longer.
You've earned yourself a reward. Pick up the folio, would you? And hand me your robe as well, I have a new one for you.
You deserve this, Player.
Return to me after you've studied a while longer.
Player, I have important news to discuss with you, but you must continue your studies. Speak with me after training a while longer.

lines.text: Hail, adventurer. The name's Matheus Griswald, of the Easthymnite Freebooters. I head up this dig site. My crew was searching for long lost relics, but our excavation has fallen into peril.
What lost relics?

There are many ancient relics within the tomb. Some of which may even be of value to you. If you help us destroy the monstrosities inside, you will earn the favor of the Freebooters. And with that, can come many benefits.
What benefits?
We know that the ancient armor of the fallen Wyrmsbane still lies within. If you bring it to us, along with certain gems, we can help you restore it.
What gems?
Are you looking to restore cloth, leather, chain or plate?
Cloth.

Bring me pieces of the old ancient cloth armor, along with the corresponding amount of Chipped Star Rose Quartz. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Chipped Star Rose Quartz, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five.
Leather.

Bring me pieces of the old ancient leather armor, along with the corresponding amount of Chipped Jasper. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Chipped Jasper, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five.
Chain.

Bring me pieces of the old ancient chain armor, along with the corresponding amount of Chipped Amber. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Chipped Amber, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five.
Plate.

Bring me pieces of the old ancient plate armor, along with the corresponding amount of Chipped Fire Opal. I'll restore waist and wrist armor with one Chipped Fire Opal, feet and hands with two, shoulders and head with three, legs with four, and chest with five.
Where can I get Chipped Star Rose Quartz
You can find from miners, or mine it yourself from Copper Veins.
